experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1197:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:3541:experiments/pose_clip_codex_synthesis.md:17:3. **PC-MSC (file16)**: pose mask 可见部位→小decoder从可见证据重建被mask部位的CLIP语义token(对齐frozen CLIP clean teacher)。**被删的token吸不走**(从输入删除)。先例: PersonMAE/PersonViT, MVP/RILS(CLIP-token MIM)。有kill-switch(random-mask vs pose-mask)。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1202:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4185:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5427:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1203:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4187:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1210:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:7402:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:14:LM-ReID test-time decision marginalization(低分辨率ReID重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test时对K=9变体[phase/bbox/kernel]做决策级边缘化)已成立: LM-S2 5分辨率全beat普通TTA / LM-S2-strong全beat强TTA(+0.76~7.28, severe LR处强TTA本身有害) / LM-S4 bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84 / K-sweep K=5达87%收益 / LM-S3聚合(logsumexp soft-marginalization在severe LR最优) / backbone泛化(Swin +7.01证不依赖SOLIDER)。**训练端定论穷尽(8机制实测+4codex 8.5/10判无空间, frozen/backbone-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize全死或证伪)**。paperstrategy判test-time+训练端反例 **6.5/10天花板**(BLC证伪→够不到7.5, 易被打成strong-TTA/ensemble)。**问: 这个工作有没有test-time或问题重定义的新角度能冲7+? 候选方向: (a)marginalization之外的test-time机制(reliability/选择性/conformal)? (b)新评测协议或问题设定让贡献更硬? (c)和相邻问题(video/multi-shot/tracklet/cross-resolution retrieval)结合? (d)6.5确实天花板该收尾投B类workshop/会议? 诚实评估别硬凑, 哪个最可能+为什么+kill-switch+信心1-10。** 务实中文。

experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1237:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8084:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3391:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_input.md:15:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1238:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8087:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3410:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:14:Review the LM-ReID fine-tuning script: the single file matching experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_*.py (exp359; design at experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md). 它 fine-tune frozen SOLIDER PoseBackboneModel(pose_dict=None → 纯 backbone global feat)成 lattice-marginalized embedding 抗采样格点(sub-pixel phase / +-1 LR-px bbox / antialias kernel)。请先 cat 该文件 + model/pose_backbone_model.py 的 forward。逐行审:
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1239:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8089:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3413:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:32:> 后 PRCV「换问题」阶段第一个 GO 的 method 候选（9 个零训练 cheap-kill 全死后）。零训练 kill-switch 已 GO（d8 lattice, agent a68e6），method-design codex 判 **CCF-B 7/10**（训练版超 frozen ensemble → 8/10）。本实验做训练版，证明 lattice-marginalization 是 **method 不是 ensemble trick**。

experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1243:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:8116:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3777:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

(b)新评测协议或问题设定让贡献更硬? (c)和相邻问题(video/multi-shot/tracklet/cross-resolution retrieval)结合? (d)6.5确实天花板该收尾投B类workshop/会议? 诚实评估别硬凑, 哪个最可能+为什么+kill-switch+信心1-10。** 务实中文。

experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1282:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:13652:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:9879:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4185:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5427:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1283:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:13653:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:9880:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/oasd_mechanism.md:4187:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1608:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_1.md:3620:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5544:reassess/r_3.md:5131:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp324b/_codex_review2.log:2647:./experiments/exp324b/claude_review.md:12:不是。exp324 frozen 已通过 kill-switch（重遮挡 pose part-MaxSim 1.86 mAP，×3.4 超整图 0.55，且均匀网格对照只 0.67 几乎不涨 → 涨点来自"姿态锚定"机制本身）。exp324b 是这个正信号的**自然下一步**：在冻结特征上训最小投影头，验证"冻结 FM 特征能否被轻量头拉到可用 ReID 判别空间"。单变量隔离干净（baseline = exp324 frozen 同 pipeline，只多了一个 413K 线性头 + BNNeck + 分类器）。这是范式/参数角度的合法探索，不属于禁止回退方向（不是 visibility 小改、不是 retrieval-side scorer 微变体、不是 test-time trick）。重点应放在实现正确性，下文逐行审。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1609:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_1.md:3622:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5546:reassess/r_3.md:5139:本地 exp109 的原始记录比当前叙述更细：oracle support bank 上界是强阳性，但它用 GT same-ID prototype，是“知道目标身份以后怎么补”的上界；这正是 donor-source-separation 必须绕开的墙。真正的 kill-switch 不能只测“泄漏能不能被检测”，必须在 frozen 特征上直接测“无 GT 身份、只按遮挡源压制后，排序是否上升”。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1610:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_1.md:3632:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5624:reassess/r_3.md:6129:./reassess.sh:19:ROLES[3]="角色=**遮挡最后一搏**。p_3提的遮挡source-separation(occlusion=别人身份污染target embedding, donor-ID泄漏)值不值得测? 但必须面对历史'occluder-gate是墙'(exp109: 即使gate掉遮挡, headroom是identity-conditioned不可实现)。设计**最锋利最便宜的kill-switch, 且必须同时回答'压制donor-ID泄漏能不能真涨ReID'**(不只是证泄漏存在——泄漏存在但压了不涨=撞墙=没用)。联网查novelty(撞TTPM/non-target-pedestrian-occlusion那批没)。如果连这都救不动或必撞墙, 诚实说'遮挡这块彻底关'。"
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1611:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_1.md:3634:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5646:reassess/r_3.md:6503:./pivot/p_3.md:2026:reid-paper 项目 D4 诊断**已确认 donor-leakage 人际混淆在强主干仍持续(≈3×物体干扰)**——kill-switch 其实已经过了。衍生"donor-leakage 反事实一致性"方法 6-7/10、待探针。**库读证明: 你这条自己的活口, 正好是整个领域的空白。**
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1612:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_1.md:3635:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5647:reassess/r_3.md:6507:./pivot/p_3.md:2045:**领域(167篇)+ 你自己的 D4 诊断 + 获胜配方 三方收敛到同一个角度: 同框入侵身份泄漏的 source-separation(非补全)。** 这是 reid-paper 项目最强活口, 也是全领域空白, 且自带打 wall-2 的对照 + 一晚的 kill-switch。下一步: 核对"主要人物归属"当年判死理由 → 不撞则跑探针 → 建 donor-leakage 反事实一致性方法。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1613:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_1.md:3637:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5651:reassess/r_3.md:6512:./pivot/p_3.md:2185:- 关键 kill-switch 很硬：冻结强 Swin embedding，训练 probe 预测遮挡者 / donor ID。若 probe 显著高于随机，且在人遮挡 split 高、物体遮挡/Market 低，这就是 B 类方法稿需要的隐藏变量。

experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1628:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_1.md:3684:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5843:reassess/r_3.md:8051:./reassess/r_3.md:5139:本地 exp109 的原始记录比当前叙述更细：oracle support bank 上界是强阳性，但它用 GT same-ID prototype，是“知道目标身份以后怎么补”的上界；这正是 donor-source-separation 必须绕开的墙。真正的 kill-switch 不能只测“泄漏能不能被检测”，必须在 frozen 特征上直接测“无 GT 身份、只按遮挡源压制后，排序是否上升”。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1630:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_1.md:3697:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5946:reassess/r_3.md:8476:角色=**遮挡最后一搏**。p_3提的遮挡source-separation(occlusion=别人身份污染target embedding, donor-ID泄漏)值不值得测? 但必须面对历史'occluder-gate是墙'(exp109: 即使gate掉遮挡, headroom是identity-conditioned不可实现)。设计**最锋利最便宜的kill-switch, 且必须同时回答'压制donor-ID泄漏能不能真涨ReID'**(不只是证泄漏存在——泄漏存在但压了不涨=撞墙=没用)。联网查novelty(撞TTPM/non-target-pedestrian-occlusion那批没)。如果连这都救不动或必撞墙, 诚实说'遮挡这块彻底关'。

experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1635:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_1.md:4018:- 关键 kill-switch 很硬：冻结强 Swin embedding，训练 probe 预测遮挡者 / donor ID。若 probe 显著高于随机，且在人遮挡 split 高、物体遮挡/Market 低，这就是 B 类方法稿需要的隐藏变量。

experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1657:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_input.md:15:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?

experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1781:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:18:问: 用这些 ON-DISK 数据, **单个最可能成的 CCF-B 方法稿方向**是什么? 重点考虑团队没碰过的 **RSTPReid text-to-image** 这条新模态(team 有强 image backbone 可当 visual encoder), 也可考虑跨域(market→occluded_reid)/多数据集泛化/新协议/训练侧创新。要给: 触发观察(在哪能找到一个具体失败) + 重定义 + 机制 + **廉价(最好零训练 frozen-feature)kill-switch** + 撞车核查(text-image ReID 很卷, IRRA/APTM/RDE/CADA 等)。**诚实: 若 text-image 也卷死、其他也都死路, 直说该把 Hubness 写 analysis short 收尾、别再撞。** 联网, 务实中文, verdict + 信心 1-10。

experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1788:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:848:./ondisk_pivot.md:18:问: 用这些 ON-DISK 数据, **单个最可能成的 CCF-B 方法稿方向**是什么? 重点考虑团队没碰过的 **RSTPReid text-to-image** 这条新模态(team 有强 image backbone 可当 visual encoder), 也可考虑跨域(market→occluded_reid)/多数据集泛化/新协议/训练侧创新。要给: 触发观察(在哪能找到一个具体失败) + 重定义 + 机制 + **廉价(最好零训练 frozen-feature)kill-switch** + 撞车核查(text-image ReID 很卷, IRRA/APTM/RDE/CADA 等)。**诚实: 若 text-image 也卷死、其他也都死路, 直说该把 Hubness 写 analysis short 收尾、别再撞。** 联网, 务实中文, verdict + 信心 1-10。

experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1794:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:953:./reassess.sh:19:ROLES[3]="角色=**遮挡最后一搏**。p_3提的遮挡source-separation(occlusion=别人身份污染target embedding, donor-ID泄漏)值不值得测? 但必须面对历史'occluder-gate是墙'(exp109: 即使gate掉遮挡, headroom是identity-conditioned不可实现)。设计**最锋利最便宜的kill-switch, 且必须同时回答'压制donor-ID泄漏能不能真涨ReID'**(不只是证泄漏存在——泄漏存在但压了不涨=撞墙=没用)。联网查novelty(撞TTPM/non-target-pedestrian-occlusion那批没)。如果连这都救不动或必撞墙, 诚实说'遮挡这块彻底关'。"

experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1828:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4393:./reassess/r_3.md:4369:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/MORNING_REPORT.md:50:2. **burstiness 抑制（exp329，搬 VLAD-BuFF/face-set）→ KILL**：frozen DINO 上前提成立（遮挡更冗余 +0.0206），但**训练好的弱 baseline 上双判据全 KILL**（burst−uniform −0.29/−0.25，遮挡反而更不冗余）。**meta-finding：ReID 训练已吸收遮挡-burstiness，连弱 baseline 也吸收 → frozen kill-switch 会骗人。**
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1834:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4430:./reassess/r_3.md:4950:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp324b/design.md:3:> **来源**：exp324 frozen 首验通过 kill-switch（姿态部位匹配在重遮挡上 ×3.4 mAP 超整图，且均匀网格不涨→涨点全来自姿态锚定）。本实验验证"训一个轻量头能否把冻结 DINO 部位特征拉到可用/可打 KPR"。

experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1843:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4446:./reassess/r_3.md:5131:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp324b/_codex_review2.log:2647:./experiments/exp324b/claude_review.md:12:不是。exp324 frozen 已通过 kill-switch（重遮挡 pose part-MaxSim 1.86 mAP，×3.4 超整图 0.55，且均匀网格对照只 0.67 几乎不涨 → 涨点来自"姿态锚定"机制本身）。exp324b 是这个正信号的**自然下一步**：在冻结特征上训最小投影头，验证"冻结 FM 特征能否被轻量头拉到可用 ReID 判别空间"。单变量隔离干净（baseline = exp324 frozen 同 pipeline，只多了一个 413K 线性头 + BNNeck + 分类器）。这是范式/参数角度的合法探索，不属于禁止回退方向（不是 visibility 小改、不是 retrieval-side scorer 微变体、不是 test-time trick）。重点应放在实现正确性，下文逐行审。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1844:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4448:./reassess/r_3.md:5139:本地 exp109 的原始记录比当前叙述更细：oracle support bank 上界是强阳性，但它用 GT same-ID prototype，是“知道目标身份以后怎么补”的上界；这正是 donor-source-separation 必须绕开的墙。真正的 kill-switch 不能只测“泄漏能不能被检测”，必须在 frozen 特征上直接测“无 GT 身份、只按遮挡源压制后，排序是否上升”。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1845:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4479:./reassess/r_3.md:6129:./reassess.sh:19:ROLES[3]="角色=**遮挡最后一搏**。p_3提的遮挡source-separation(occlusion=别人身份污染target embedding, donor-ID泄漏)值不值得测? 但必须面对历史'occluder-gate是墙'(exp109: 即使gate掉遮挡, headroom是identity-conditioned不可实现)。设计**最锋利最便宜的kill-switch, 且必须同时回答'压制donor-ID泄漏能不能真涨ReID'**(不只是证泄漏存在——泄漏存在但压了不涨=撞墙=没用)。联网查novelty(撞TTPM/non-target-pedestrian-occlusion那批没)。如果连这都救不动或必撞墙, 诚实说'遮挡这块彻底关'。"
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1847:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4496:./reassess/r_3.md:6503:./pivot/p_3.md:2026:reid-paper 项目 D4 诊断**已确认 donor-leakage 人际混淆在强主干仍持续(≈3×物体干扰)**——kill-switch 其实已经过了。衍生"donor-leakage 反事实一致性"方法 6-7/10、待探针。**库读证明: 你这条自己的活口, 正好是整个领域的空白。**
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1848:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4497:./reassess/r_3.md:6507:./pivot/p_3.md:2045:**领域(167篇)+ 你自己的 D4 诊断 + 获胜配方 三方收敛到同一个角度: 同框入侵身份泄漏的 source-separation(非补全)。** 这是 reid-paper 项目最强活口, 也是全领域空白, 且自带打 wall-2 的对照 + 一晚的 kill-switch。下一步: 核对"主要人物归属"当年判死理由 → 不撞则跑探针 → 建 donor-leakage 反事实一致性方法。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1849:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4498:./reassess/r_3.md:6512:./pivot/p_3.md:2185:- 关键 kill-switch 很硬：冻结强 Swin embedding，训练 probe 预测遮挡者 / donor ID。若 probe 显著高于随机，且在人遮挡 split 高、物体遮挡/Market 低，这就是 B 类方法稿需要的隐藏变量。

experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1946:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_2.md:2866:../../cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_3.md:1555:- **kill-switch(零训练)**: frozen Swin(swin_fix256, 67.33)提特征, CARGO A↔G: 对称cosine vs 非对称包含距离(航拍当宽高斯/地面窄高斯, 用马氏或KL包含)。包含明显赢 → re-framing 有腿; 打平 → 死, 回头。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1947:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_2.md:2868:../../cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_3.md:1561:- **kill-switch**: frozen Swin, 中性特征(去视角分量)+视角特有残差 分开重组 vs avg。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1948:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_2.md:2896:../../cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_3.md:1864:写零训练 kill-switch 脚本(复用 error_analysis_geom.py 基建: frozen Swin 提 μ + σ, CARGO A↔G, 8 破坏对照 + SMPL 分桶)。GPU: lab-3090(CARGO + swin_fix256 ckpt 在)。先双审? —— 这是零训练诊断脚本不是训练, 但仍走 codex 审一遍脚本正确性再跑。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1951:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_2.md:2904:../../cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_3.md:2026:reid-paper 项目 D4 诊断**已确认 donor-leakage 人际混淆在强主干仍持续(≈3×物体干扰)**——kill-switch 其实已经过了。衍生"donor-leakage 反事实一致性"方法 6-7/10、待探针。**库读证明: 你这条自己的活口, 正好是整个领域的空白。**
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1952:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_2.md:2905:../../cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_3.md:2045:**领域(167篇)+ 你自己的 D4 诊断 + 获胜配方 三方收敛到同一个角度: 同框入侵身份泄漏的 source-separation(非补全)。** 这是 reid-paper 项目最强活口, 也是全领域空白, 且自带打 wall-2 的对照 + 一晚的 kill-switch。下一步: 核对"主要人物归属"当年判死理由 → 不撞则跑探针 → 建 donor-leakage 反事实一致性方法。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1953:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_2.md:2918:../../cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_3.md:2185:- 关键 kill-switch 很硬：冻结强 Swin embedding，训练 probe 预测遮挡者 / donor ID。若 probe 显著高于随机，且在人遮挡 split 高、物体遮挡/Market 低，这就是 B 类方法稿需要的隐藏变量。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:1954:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_2.md:2925:../../cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_3.md:2219:- 关键 kill-embedding 无测试期额外输入口径下超过全部已发表 B 类遮挡方法（最高 FLaN-Net 65.5；arXiv 的 DPL-ReID 67.2 要测试期文本）。旧的 batch32"基线"64.4 作废。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21268:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2103:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4171:./reassess/r_3.md:2775:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:26:角色=**转向者**。假设 avg>MaxSim 这个 hook 是死胡同(反复 reduce to avg)。团队资产=SMPL人体几何基建 + Swin/SOLIDER backbone + CARGO/AG-ReID.v2 数据 + 遮挡/VI-ReID 历史。用 22 招式 + 联网, 提 1-2 个**换问题**的 B 类方向(可以离开 avg>MaxSim 甚至离开纯 aerial-ground), 每个带: 触发观察/重定义/机制怎么长/廉价 kill-switch/撞车核查。重点用团队独有的 SMPL 几何当差异化(但记住 exp333 证 SMPL-β≈random, 别再走那条)。务实中文。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21294:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2167:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4235:./reassess/r_3.md:3205:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:4500:角色=**转向者**。假设 avg>MaxSim 这个 hook 是死胡同(反复 reduce to avg)。团队资产=SMPL人体几何基建 + Swin/SOLIDER backbone + CARGO/AG-ReID.v2 数据 + 遮挡/VI-ReID 历史。用 22 招式 + 联网, 提 1-2 个**换问题**的 B 类方向(可以离开 avg>MaxSim 甚至离开纯 aerial-ground), 每个带: 触发观察/重定义/机制怎么长/廉价 kill-switch/撞车核查。重点用团队独有的 SMPL 几何当差异化(但记住 exp333 证 SMPL-β≈random, 别再走那条)。务实中文。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21305:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2209:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4277:./reassess/r_3.md:3496:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_13.md:3256:“多分支、多粒度、多尺度”本身已经很拥挤。能发 B 类的不是再拼一个分支，而是先指出一个被忽略的真实失败机制，再让机制服务这个问题。对我们来说，最值得借的是三类写法：显式对齐、可靠性建模、源域或视角不平衡。衣服文本和普通多分支换衣方向不建议正面进入，除非能被 SMPL 或航拍地面的几何问题重新定义。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21308:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2214:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4283:./reassess/r_3.md:3591:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_2.md:419:- **★ exp015a 定稿：Occ-Duke Swin-Small 干净基线三种子 66.53±0.12 / 75.73±0.21（batch64）**。单 embedding 无测试期额外输入口径下超过全部已发表 B 类遮挡方法（最高 FLaN-Net 65.5；arXiv 的 DPL-ReID 67.2 要测试期文本）。旧的 batch32"基线"64.4 作废。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21325:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2298:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4375:./reassess/r_3.md:4099:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_codex_bundle/reviews/_verdicts.txt:149:degradation 实现是：只对 ground 样本做 normalized tensor 空间的 bilinear downsample 再 upsample，`s~U(0.25,1)`，无 blur；日志 `deg_scale_mean≈0.624/0.625` 正常。consistency 是 clean logits detach 作为 teacher，degraded rec logits 做 KL，`tau=4`，乘 `tau^2`，形式上是标准 KD/consistency loss。iso 下 `rec_only=True` 会在 stage-3 fork 处 detach，f_full BNNeck 不跑 degraded 图，未看到明显梯度泄漏。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21331:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2326:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4615:./reassess/r_3.md:7829:./reassess/r_3.md:2469:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_24.md:403:审查只拦实质问题：代码正确性的错误、数据泄漏、评测协议前后不一致、变量没隔离干净、比较不公平。操作上、文档上的小问题，可以记成待办，但不要拦。结论写进 `experiments/expNNN/review-codex.md`。通过时要明确写“无实质问题”“approve”“审查通过”或“放行”。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21332:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2336:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4625:./reassess/r_3.md:7867:./reassess/r_3.md:2890:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:1062:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1526:2. 重定义动作：他们把遮挡问题重定义成 language-guided noise filtering，而不是简单的 visible part matching。更关键的是，他们把图像内容拆成三个语义类别：主体身份、可见属性、遮挡物。关键词是 categorical attention、fine-grained prompt、occlusion-aware prompt、subject token、attribute token、context token。这个重定义把“遮挡”从一个空间缺失问题变成了一个语义分类和噪声过滤问题。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21333:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2346:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4635:./reassess/r_3.md:7901:./reassess/r_3.md:3351:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:1785:主文档确认了一个关键背景：遮挡方向已有大量“补全、可见性、结构关系、masking、metric alignment”负结果，且 exp109 一类结论确实在说可实现的遮挡处理很容易退化成 identity-conditioned oracle 不可达。现在我会专门检索本地 GOPL、source-separation、occluder-gate 相关材料，再做外部 novelty 对照。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21334:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2352:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4643:./reassess/r_3.md:7956:./reassess/r_3.md:4099:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_codex_bundle/reviews/_verdicts.txt:149:degradation 实现是：只对 ground 样本做 normalized tensor 空间的 bilinear downsample 再 upsample，`s~U(0.25,1)`，无 blur；日志 `deg_scale_mean≈0.624/0.625` 正常。consistency 是 clean logits detach 作为 teacher，degraded rec logits 做 KL，`tau=4`，乘 `tau^2`，形式上是标准 KD/consistency loss。iso 下 `rec_only=True` 会在 stage-3 fork 处 detach，f_full BNNeck 不跑 degraded 图，未看到明显梯度泄漏。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21335:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2354:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4645:./reassess/r_3.md:7958:./reassess/r_3.md:4101:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_codex_bundle/reviews/_verdicts.txt:169:  `full_map.detach()` 的位置足以切断梯度，但它发生在 f_full Swin late stages 和 `layer4` 已经执行之后。也就是说 degraded `rec_only` pass 仍计算了 f_full 激活并消耗随机层 RNG；只是这些结果不进 loss、不更新 f_full BNNeck/权重。这是注释“cheap / no f_full grad graph built”的夸大，不是梯度泄漏。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21336:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2357:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4824:./reassess/r_3.md:9614:analyses/deep_28.txt:77:它把 LVLM 从“生成描述的外部工具”改写成“产生身份语义 token 的特征提取器组成部分”。关键词是 LVLM-ReID、Pedestrian Semantic Token Generation、`<REID>` token、Semantic-Guided Interaction、reinforced semantic token、generative language models assist discriminative visual models。旧问题是“怎么给 ReID 加文本语义”，新问题是“怎样把 LVLM 的生成过程变成 ReID 的身份表示”。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21340:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2361:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4891:./reassess/r_3.md:11148:reviews/deep_19.md:625:- A 语义/VLM teacher: 已完成,见 experiments/paper_materials/newinfo_semantic_teacher-codex.md。结论是遮挡语义 teacher 对 SOLIDER 强主干整体偏负,FLaN-Net/π-VL/AG-ReID/LVLM-ReID/RMPSNet 等发表遮挡成绩多低于或接近现有强基线; 唯一值得先探的是属性 teacher 的可靠性噪声屏蔽,其次是 teacher 只用于属性级样本组织,两者都必须先做零训练探针。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21526:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2784:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3675:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:16:1. **训练动力学风险(High×2)**：早期 epoch OVP loss 会**结构性退化为零梯度**(冷启动稀疏 + 单列有效 → CE=0)，同时 `tau=0.05` 在随机原型上会给出**尖锐梯度尖峰**。两者叠加 → OVP 的 `meters['ovp']` 早期打印 ~0 不是收敛而是退化，监控会被误导，且 λ 早期实际不起作用。这不是 bug，但会让 kill-switch #2("ep10/20 ≥+1.0")的判读失真。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21527:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2794:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3685:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:69:  - **MBCE(AAAI23, VI-ReID)**：modality-aware centroid proxies + momentum memory + cross-modality 对齐——同构，且已在 person ReID 发表。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21528:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2801:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1641:reassess/r_3.md:3615:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_2.md:3475:cheap kill-switch：按 SMPL 可见性做 token dropout 或 surface dropout，小规模训练 5 到 10 个 epoch。必须证明它比随机擦除、随机 token dropout 更能改善极端视角子集，否则只是普通增广。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21529:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2805:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1645:reassess/r_3.md:3621:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_2.md:3520:区别：它和 AOANet 的区别是不用 2D 自适应分块讲遮挡，而是用 SMPL 表面可见性定义哪些证据可比较。它和 `Beyond geometry` 的区别是避开完整 UVTexture 和重排序，重点做低清航拍到地面里的可观测性约束，目标是训练出单 embedding 或表面 token embedding。  
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21530:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2815:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1655:reassess/r_3.md:3646:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_10.md:362:**部位/掩码方向终审判负**（exp022-026，约30次训练，账本在 results.md + decisions.md#44）：抗遮挡重加权、构造掩码监督(软/硬)、语言部位分支(含忠实LGPA-D)全部在强主干上不成立。三路codex法医结论：PSG的姿态接地是LGPA-D全部集成选择的承重墙，无姿态版必败。唯一幸存=遮挡物贴图增广(Swin +0.83/+1.10)，但有先例非方法级。exp026确认种子(no-detach s1/s2)在 hyy 跑完即封档，不阻塞选向。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21538:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2925:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1766:reassess/r_3.md:3895:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_9.md:3386:我会优先押第 1 个和第 2 个。它们的问题层面更清楚，也最能把团队的 aerial-ground 和 SMPL 基建变成别人不容易复刻的机制。第 3 个有潜力，但依赖视频或稳定 SMPL 质量。第 4 个成本最低，适合作为辅助机制，不适合单独当 B 类主贡献。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21540:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2973:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1814:reassess/r_3.md:4009:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2668:和这批最像工作的区别：它最像 HDNet 的“层级解耦”，但 HDNet 用对抗学习去掉相机和模态噪声，我们用 SMPL 投影显式定义哪些身体表面在航拍和地面视角中可比。它也不同于 LVLM-ReID 的语义 token，我们的 token 是几何可见性和人体表面，不是语言生成语义。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21541:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2979:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1820:reassess/r_3.md:4016:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2698:和这批最像工作的区别：它最像 LVLM-ReID，但 LVLM-ReID 推理时仍用 LVLM 生成 `<REID>` token，成本高且语义偏外观。我们的 token 来自 SMPL joints、mesh visibility、2D projection 和 pose confidence，只在训练期蒸馏到 SOLIDER 特征，测试仍是单 embedding。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21542:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2981:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1822:reassess/r_3.md:4018:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2702:我最建议优先试候选 1。它同时占“问题新”和“机制新”，和这批论文的切开点清楚，也最能发挥你们已经打通的 SMPL 基建。候选 3 是问题层面最像 B 类故事的备选，但需要一点真实歧义证据支撑，否则容易变成普通鲁棒损失。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21546:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2999:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1845:reassess/r_3.md:4099:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_codex_bundle/reviews/_verdicts.txt:149:degradation 实现是：只对 ground 样本做 normalized tensor 空间的 bilinear downsample 再 upsample，`s~U(0.25,1)`，无 blur；日志 `deg_scale_mean≈0.624/0.625` 正常。consistency 是 clean logits detach 作为 teacher，degraded rec logits 做 KL，`tau=4`，乘 `tau^2`，形式上是标准 KD/consistency loss。iso 下 `rec_only=True` 会在 stage-3 fork 处 detach，f_full BNNeck 不跑 degraded 图，未看到明显梯度泄漏。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21575:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3189:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4242:reassess/r_2.md:1264:reassess/r_3.md:2823:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:655:./analyses/deep_25.txt:37:5. **reviewer 为什么买账**：这篇卖的是视角加表示范式。novelty 不在“用 gait”本身，而在“把 3D gait 从稀疏骨架或低维参数，重做成 2D 视频域稠密场”。这是比较像方法稿的创新构造：有明确旧表示缺陷，有自然机制，有替换模态消融和可视化支撑。缺点是工程重、依赖训练期 3D recovery，但作者通过推理期不需要 SMPL 来缓解这个风险。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21583:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3268:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4321:reassess/r_2.md:1602:reassess/r_3.md:3496:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_13.md:3256:“多分支、多粒度、多尺度”本身已经很拥挤。能发 B 类的不是再拼一个分支，而是先指出一个被忽略的真实失败机制，再让机制服务这个问题。对我们来说，最值得借的是三类写法：显式对齐、可靠性建模、源域或视角不平衡。衣服文本和普通多分支换衣方向不建议正面进入，除非能被 SMPL 或航拍地面的几何问题重新定义。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21584:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3270:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4323:reassess/r_2.md:1612:reassess/r_3.md:3510:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_13.md:3331:“多分支、多粒度、多尺度”本身已经很拥挤。能发 B 类的不是再拼一个分支，而是先指出一个被忽略的真实失败机制，再让机制服务这个问题。对我们来说，最值得借的是三类写法：显式对齐、可靠性建模、源域或视角不平衡。衣服文本和普通多分支换衣方向不建议正面进入，除非能被 SMPL 或航拍地面的几何问题重新定义。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21585:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3279:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4332:reassess/r_2.md:1641:reassess/r_3.md:3615:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_2.md:3475:cheap kill-switch：按 SMPL 可见性做 token dropout 或 surface dropout，小规模训练 5 到 10 个 epoch。必须证明它比随机擦除、随机 token dropout 更能改善极端视角子集，否则只是普通增广。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21586:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3286:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4339:reassess/r_2.md:1655:reassess/r_3.md:3646:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_10.md:362:**部位/掩码方向终审判负**（exp022-026，约30次训练，账本在 results.md + decisions.md#44）：抗遮挡重加权、构造掩码监督(软/硬)、语言部位分支(含忠实LGPA-D)全部在强主干上不成立。三路codex法医结论：PSG的姿态接地是LGPA-D全部集成选择的承重墙，无姿态版必败。唯一幸存=遮挡物贴图增广(Swin +0.83/+1.10)，但有先例非方法级。exp026确认种子(no-detach s1/s2)在 hyy 跑完即封档，不阻塞选向。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21587:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3287:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4340:reassess/r_2.md:1656:reassess/r_3.md:3665:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_10.md:687:target individuals among multiple non-overlapping camera viewpoints.
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21588:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3332:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:4385:reassess/r_2.md:1814:reassess/r_3.md:4009:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2668:和这批最像工作的区别：它最像 HDNet 的“层级解耦”，但 HDNet 用对抗学习去掉相机和模态噪声，我们用 SMPL 投影显式定义哪些身体表面在航拍和地面视角中可比。它也不同于 LVLM-ReID 的语义 token，我们的 token 是几何可见性和人体表面，不是语言生成语义。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21599:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3387:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5022:reassess/r_3.md:2759:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_17.md:6450:4. 证据闭环：关键不是只报最终涨点，而是分别证明 DMM 和 CDCN 的角色。消融显示 DMM 提升抗遗忘但会牺牲适应性，CDCN 提升适应性并改善记忆，二者组合互相补偿。另一个关键证据是 DMM 只放在重放阶段最好，放在适应阶段会污染相机认知节点。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21605:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3408:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5043:reassess/r_3.md:2823:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:655:./analyses/deep_25.txt:37:5. **reviewer 为什么买账**：这篇卖的是视角加表示范式。novelty 不在“用 gait”本身，而在“把 3D gait 从稀疏骨架或低维参数，重做成 2D 视频域稠密场”。这是比较像方法稿的创新构造：有明确旧表示缺陷，有自然机制，有替换模态消融和可视化支撑。缺点是工程重、依赖训练期 3D recovery，但作者通过推理期不需要 SMPL 来缓解这个风险。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21615:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3541:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5176:reassess/r_3.md:3476:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_13.md:291:阅读已完成：167 篇全覆盖。38 篇范围内精读 + 88 篇范围外粗读由 codex 完成（笔记 paper_notes/notes/in_*.md、out_*.md），剩 41 篇因 codex 额度耗尽（2026-06-11 13:01 恢复）由 Claude 摘要级补读（missing_41_skim_by_claude.md）。元分析和候选方向写在 **paper_notes/SYNTHESIS.md**，要点：(1) 在"单 embedding、测试无额外输入"口径下我们的 SOLIDER Swin-Small 纯基线 66.5 已处于已发表 B 类遮挡工作头部（发表水位 57.8-65.5，仅 arXiv 的 DPL-ReID 67.2 和测试期多部件距离的 AOANet 70.6 更高）；(2) 模块类增益=弱基线假象（这批论文内部基线 48-53 起步），反向验证我们 13 个判负；(3) 站得住的增益全部来自训练期新信息源（VLM 语义/外部遮挡物数据/生成数据/分布先验）；(4) 空白=遮挡结构化 VLM 语义当纯训练期监督蒸馏进非 CLIP 强人本主干、测试回纯单 embedding，没人做过。候选 A=该语义蒸馏方向（先零训练探针：冻结 SOLIDER 特征能否线性解码 CLIP 属性/遮挡物标签，解码不出的残差是否关联检索错误）；候选 B=真实遮挡物数据源+分布先验（最便宜，A 的对照轴）；候选 C=干净到遮挡的结构保持蒸馏（中风险排队）；候选 D=可靠检索稿保底投 PRCV。待办：codex 额度恢复后对候选 A 做独立新颖性红队，然后交用户挑方向。未开任何实验。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21616:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3551:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5186:reassess/r_3.md:3496:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_13.md:3256:“多分支、多粒度、多尺度”本身已经很拥挤。能发 B 类的不是再拼一个分支，而是先指出一个被忽略的真实失败机制，再让机制服务这个问题。对我们来说，最值得借的是三类写法：显式对齐、可靠性建模、源域或视角不平衡。衣服文本和普通多分支换衣方向不建议正面进入，除非能被 SMPL 或航拍地面的几何问题重新定义。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21619:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3565:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5201:reassess/r_3.md:3596:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_2.md:437:阅读已完成：167 篇全覆盖。38 篇范围内精读 + 88 篇范围外粗读由 codex 完成（笔记 paper_notes/notes/in_*.md、out_*.md），剩 41 篇因 codex 额度耗尽（2026-06-11 13:01 恢复）由 Claude 摘要级补读（missing_41_skim_by_claude.md）。元分析和候选方向写在 **paper_notes/SYNTHESIS.md**，要点：(1) 在"单 embedding、测试无额外输入"口径下我们的 SOLIDER Swin-Small 纯基线 66.5 已处于已发表 B 类遮挡工作头部（发表水位 57.8-65.5，仅 arXiv 的 DPL-ReID 67.2 和测试期多部件距离的 AOANet 70.6 更高）；(2) 模块类增益=弱基线假象（这批论文内部基线 48-53 起步），反向验证我们 13 个判负；(3) 站得住的增益全部来自训练期新信息源（VLM 语义/外部遮挡物数据/生成数据/分布先验）；(4) 空白=遮挡结构化 VLM 语义当纯训练期监督蒸馏进非 CLIP 强人本主干、测试回纯单 embedding，没人做过。候选 A=该语义蒸馏方向（先零训练探针：冻结 SOLIDER 特征能否线性解码 CLIP 属性/遮挡物标签，解码不出的残差是否关联检索错误）；候选 B=真实遮挡物数据源+分布先验（最便宜，A 的对照轴）；候选 C=干净到遮挡的结构保持蒸馏（中风险排队）；候选 D=可靠检索稿保底投 PRCV。待办：codex 额度恢复后对候选 A 做独立新颖性红队，然后交用户挑方向。未开任何实验。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21620:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3574:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5210:reassess/r_3.md:3615:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_2.md:3475:cheap kill-switch：按 SMPL 可见性做 token dropout 或 surface dropout，小规模训练 5 到 10 个 epoch。必须证明它比随机擦除、随机 token dropout 更能改善极端视角子集，否则只是普通增广。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21636:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3689:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5333:reassess/r_3.md:4009:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2668:和这批最像工作的区别：它最像 HDNet 的“层级解耦”，但 HDNet 用对抗学习去掉相机和模态噪声，我们用 SMPL 投影显式定义哪些身体表面在航拍和地面视角中可比。它也不同于 LVLM-ReID 的语义 token，我们的 token 是几何可见性和人体表面，不是语言生成语义。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21637:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3693:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5337:reassess/r_3.md:4018:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2702:我最建议优先试候选 1。它同时占“问题新”和“机制新”，和这批论文的切开点清楚，也最能发挥你们已经打通的 SMPL 基建。候选 3 是问题层面最像 B 类故事的备选，但需要一点真实歧义证据支撑，否则容易变成普通鲁棒损失。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21648:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3824:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/analyses/deep_28.txt:77:它把 LVLM 从“生成描述的外部工具”改写成“产生身份语义 token 的特征提取器组成部分”。关键词是 LVLM-ReID、Pedestrian Semantic Token Generation、`<REID>` token、Semantic-Guided Interaction、reinforced semantic token、generative language models assist discriminative visual models。旧问题是“怎么给 ReID 加文本语义”，新问题是“怎样把 LVLM 的生成过程变成 ReID 的身份表示”。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21649:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3825:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_10.md:493:- A 语义/VLM teacher: 已完成,见 experiments/paper_materials/newinfo_semantic_teacher-codex.md。结论是遮挡语义 teacher 对 SOLIDER 强主干整体偏负,FLaN-Net/π-VL/AG-ReID/LVLM-ReID/RMPSNet 等发表遮挡成绩多低于或接近现有强基线; 唯一值得先探的是属性 teacher 的可靠性噪声屏蔽,其次是 teacher 只用于属性级样本组织,两者都必须先做零训练探针。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21691:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3867:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:3:> 后 PRCV「换问题」阶段第一个 GO 的 method 候选（9 个零训练 cheap-kill 全死后）。零训练 kill-switch 已 GO（d8 lattice, agent a68e6），method-design codex 判 **CCF-B 7/10**（训练版超 frozen ensemble → 8/10）。本实验做训练版，证明 lattice-marginalization 是 **method 不是 ensemble trick**。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21692:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3868:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:4:> 设计来源：`experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt`（完整 codex 设计）+ `cvpb_lattice_result.md`（kill-switch 数据）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21693:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3869:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:8:低分辨率 ReID 的传统视角：LR = 模糊/缺细节，解法 = SR / resolution-invariant feature。**我们重定义**：一部分 LR 失败不是"缺信息"，而是 **采样格点不确定性（sampling-lattice uncertainty）**——同一个 HR 身份在不同合法的 LR 采样格点（sub-pixel phase / bbox alignment / downsample kernel）下，落到不同 embedding 区域，导致 rank-1 身份翻转。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21694:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3870:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:11:frozen exp260b Market，K=9 lattice variants ensemble，HR gallery / LR query：
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21695:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3871:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:20:两个生死控制都过：**vs 普通 TTA**（同 K 同 MaxSim，lattice 比 TTA 多 +3.04，证 lattice-specific 非 TTA 换名；lat-MaxSim 46.9 > tta 43.8 > single 42.6，无"输给 trivial baseline"问题）；**vs #false-in-topk**（phase-var partial +0.19/+0.21 存活）。机制：phase-var 是 TTA-var 的 **7.5×**；74.9% h=16 query 跨 lattice 翻转 rank-1，随 h 升单调衰减到 1.2%（h=48 机制消失 = 低分辨率专用现象）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21696:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3872:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:23:phase-var 作 per-query 失败预测器**不干净**（控 LR-severity 后 partial 塌到 ≈0，与 per-image LR 失真共线）。**GO 靠的是 interventional 结果**（ensemble +4.2 / LAT−TTA +3.0 是直接测量）。故事写成 "lattice sensitivity 是 **mechanism-level nuisance**, 不是 standalone failure predictor"，方法是对所有 severe-LR query 做 marginalization（不是预测哪张失败）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21697:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3873:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:27:训练一个 lattice-marginalized embedding（对 lattice variants 身份稳定）+ 推理 K-marginalization，在 h=16 上比 frozen lattice ensemble **再高 +0.8~2.0 mAP** → 证明它学到了 lattice-invariance（是 method），不是 ensemble trick。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21698:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3874:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:33:2. fine-tune：HR train image 在线生成 LR lattice variants `x^l = U(D_l(x))`，l ∈ {sub-pixel phase, bbox jitter, downsample kernel}。每图每 iter 采样 M=2-4 variants，eval 用 K=9。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21699:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3875:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:36:### LM-ReID loss
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21700:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3876:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:42:L_adv  = GRL-CE(Dφ(z^l), lattice_label_l)                        # 弱：去掉 embedding 中可预测 lattice label
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21701:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3877:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:60:失败最可能原因：训练版只 ≈ frozen ensemble（没学到额外 lattice-invariance）→ 沦为 test-time ensemble trick，不成方法稿。备选投稿角度：同等 mAP 下 K 从 9 降到 3 或 single inference 保留大部分收益。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21702:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3878:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:66:- **frozen lattice ensemble**（零训练 K=9，= kill-switch 的 +4.23，这是训练版必须超过的硬线）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21703:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3879:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:75:- 新指标：PRF@1（phase rank-flip rate）、Flip Entropy、LEG（lattice ensemble gain）、LOTG（lattice-over-TTA gain）、query ΔAP。按 h 分报 + paired bootstrap 95% CI + K=1/3/5/9 曲线 + compute cost。PRF 随 h（74.9%→31%→10%→1.2%）是强故事线。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21704:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3880:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:79:- **VPFA**（2510.00936，最近邻）：CR-ReID = feature-space resolution direction，Vector Panning LR→pseudo-HR。hidden variable 是 resolution gap/feature direction，**不是 sampling lattice，不做 lattice marginalization**。必须正面对比。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21705:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3881:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:80:- LRAR（2207.13037）：resolution-adaptive representation，占"resolution adaptive"词 → 我们 novelty 写 sampling-lattice uncertainty。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21706:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3882:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:81:- RFD（2109.07871）：multi-res gallery distillation，占"resolution-invariant distillation"，没占 lattice intervention。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21707:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3883:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:82:- BlurPool（1904.11486）：anti-aliasing/shift-invariance 已老 → **不能说首次发现 aliasing 影响**。**能声称**：首次在 LR person ReID 把采样格点作隐藏变量 + rank-level intervention 证明 + lattice-specific marginalization 解决检索身份翻转。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21708:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3884:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:83:- FlipReID（2105.05639）：ReID 常用 flip-mean TTA → **必须反复强调非 TTA 换名**（同 K vs-TTA 控制，lattice 多 +3.04）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21709:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3885:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:87:operating point 低（只在 h≤24 强 +3-4 mAP，h=32 marginal）→ 主动收窄定位 **"severe low-resolution / cross-resolution ReID under sampling-lattice uncertainty"**，不写成通用 ReID 鲁棒性稿。h=32 marginal 反而支持机制（分辨率升高 → lattice uncertainty 消退）。真正风险 = 训练版打不过 frozen ensemble，那就只是 ensemble trick。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21723:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3899:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:14:- **Medium** [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:372](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:372), [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:377](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:377): GRL adversarial loss is lambda-scaled twice for the backbone gradient: once inside `GradReverse(..., adv_lamb)` and once in `+ adv_lamb * L_adv`. experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21726:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3902:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:34:I did not find an exact prior for “sampling-lattice hidden variable / sub-pixel phase marginalization” in low-res ReID. experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21733:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3909:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:32:> 后 PRCV「换问题」阶段第一个 GO 的 method 候选（9 个零训练 cheap-kill 全死后）。零训练 kill-switch 已 GO（d8 lattice, agent a68e6），method-design codex 判 **CCF-B 7/10**（训练版超 frozen ensemble → 8/10）。本实验做训练版，证明 lattice-marginalization 是 **method 不是 ensemble trick**。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21734:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3910:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:33:> 设计来源：`experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt`（完整 codex 设计）+ `cvpb_lattice_result.md`（kill-switch 数据）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21735:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3911:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:37:低分辨率 ReID 的传统视角：LR = 模糊/缺细节，解法 = SR / resolution-invariant feature。**我们重定义**：一部分 LR 失败不是"缺信息"，而是 **采样格点不确定性（sampling-lattice uncertainty）**——同一个 HR 身份在不同合法的 LR 采样格点（sub-pixel phase / bbox alignment / downsample kernel）下，落到不同 embedding 区域，导致 rank-1 身份翻转。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21736:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3912:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:40:frozen exp260b Market，K=9 lattice variants ensemble，HR gallery / LR query：
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21737:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3913:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:49:两个生死控制都过：**vs 普通 TTA**（同 K 同 MaxSim，lattice 比 TTA 多 +3.04，证 lattice-specific 非 TTA 换名；lat-MaxSim 46.9 > tta 43.8 > single 42.6，无"输给 trivial baseline"问题）；**vs #false-in-topk**（phase-var partial +0.19/+0.21 存活）。机制：phase-var 是 TTA-var 的 **7.5×**；74.9% h=16 query 跨 lattice 翻转 rank-1，随 h 升单调衰减到 1.2%（h=48 机制消失 = 低分辨率专用现象）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21738:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3914:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:52:phase-var 作 per-query 失败预测器**不干净**（控 LR-severity 后 partial 塌到 ≈0，与 per-image LR 失真共线）。**GO 靠的是 interventional 结果**（ensemble +4.2 / LAT−TTA +3.0 是直接测量）。故事写成 "lattice sensitivity 是 **mechanism-level nuisance**, 不是 standalone failure predictor"，方法是对所有 severe-LR query 做 marginalization（不是预测哪张失败）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21739:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3915:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:56:训练一个 lattice-marginalized embedding（对 lattice variants 身份稳定）+ 推理 K-marginalization，在 h=16 上比 frozen lattice ensemble **再高 +0.8~2.0 mAP** → 证明它学到了 lattice-invariance（是 method），不是 ensemble trick。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21740:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3916:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:62:2. fine-tune：HR train image 在线生成 LR lattice variants `x^l = U(D_l(x))`，l ∈ {sub-pixel phase, bbox jitter, downsample kernel}。每图每 iter 采样 M=2-4 variants，eval 用 K=9。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21741:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3917:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:65:### LM-ReID loss
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21742:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3918:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:71:L_adv  = GRL-CE(Dφ(z^l), lattice_label_l)                        # 弱：去掉 embedding 中可预测 lattice label
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21743:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3919:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:89:失败最可能原因：训练版只 ≈ frozen ensemble（没学到额外 lattice-invariance）→ 沦为 test-time ensemble trick，不成方法稿。备选投稿角度：同等 mAP 下 K 从 9 降到 3 或 single inference 保留大部分收益。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21744:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3920:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:95:- **frozen lattice ensemble**（零训练 K=9，= kill-switch 的 +4.23，这是训练版必须超过的硬线）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21745:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3921:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:104:- 新指标：PRF@1（phase rank-flip rate）、Flip Entropy、LEG（lattice ensemble gain）、LOTG（lattice-over-TTA gain）、query ΔAP。按 h 分报 + paired bootstrap 95% CI + K=1/3/5/9 曲线 + compute cost。PRF 随 h（74.9%→31%→10%→1.2%）是强故事线。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21746:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3922:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:108:- **VPFA**（2510.00936，最近邻）：CR-ReID = feature-space resolution direction，Vector Panning LR→pseudo-HR。hidden variable 是 resolution gap/feature direction，**不是 sampling lattice，不做 lattice marginalization**。必须正面对比。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21747:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3923:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:109:- LRAR（2207.13037）：resolution-adaptive representation，占"resolution adaptive"词 → 我们 novelty 写 sampling-lattice uncertainty。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21748:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3924:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:110:- RFD（2109.07871）：multi-res gallery distillation，占"resolution-invariant distillation"，没占 lattice intervention。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21749:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3925:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:111:- BlurPool（1904.11486）：anti-aliasing/shift-invariance 已老 → **不能说首次发现 aliasing 影响**。**能声称**：首次在 LR person ReID 把采样格点作隐藏变量 + rank-level intervention 证明 + lattice-specific marginalization 解决检索身份翻转。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21750:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3926:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:112:- FlipReID（2105.05639）：ReID 常用 flip-mean TTA → **必须反复强调非 TTA 换名**（同 K vs-TTA 控制，lattice 多 +3.04）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21751:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3927:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:116:operating point 低（只在 h≤24 强 +3-4 mAP，h=32 marginal）→ 主动收窄定位 **"severe low-resolution / cross-resolution ReID under sampling-lattice uncertainty"**，不写成通用 ReID 鲁棒性稿。h=32 marginal 反而支持机制（分辨率升高 → lattice uncertainty 消退）。真正风险 = 训练版打不过 frozen ensemble，那就只是 ensemble trick。

The key requirement passes: OVLI projection params are added via `list(model.parameters()) + list(ovli.parameters())`, and the optimizer assert checks `ovli.proj.parameters()` are present: [afd_train.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/afd_train.py:559).

The loss correctly skips anchors without both opposite-view positive and negative candidates: [afd_train.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/afd_train.py:316), but logs only loss/pos/neg/gap: [afd_train.py](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/afd_train.py:677). Add `valid_anchor_frac`, `pos_per_valid`, `neg_per_valid` before long training so low OVLI loss is not confused with “no valid anchors.”

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21992:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4488:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1849:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5782:./reassess/r_3.md:3108:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:3322:./validate/v_3.md:15165:../litreview2/validate/v_3.md:7365:./validate/v_3.md:2751:../codex_review_ovli.txt:3956:experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:44:- **exp324d 第2次（本次）已启动**（2026-06-16，lab-3090-d）：`scripts/exp324d_lora.py` 写好——LoRA(q/v rank8 alpha16) 解冻 DINOv2-base + **可微姿态部位池化**(预算每图 row-stochastic 池化矩阵 pool_w，`bmm(pool_w,patch)` 梯度回流 LoRA) + exp324b 同款头/损失/PK64/part-MaxSim eval。**唯一变量=LoRA 解冻 DINO**。双审查 approve（Claude 含 200-trial 池化等价 1.79e-7；Codex 141k tok 确认梯度到 LoRA/full-batch triplet/use_reentrant=False/eval 对称，组合 plausibly new 未找直接先例）。Dry-run：LoRA 294,912+head 413,184 训练，loss↓ acc 0.016→0.766，显存 13.7G/24G，~1.4s/step。全量 35ep 后台跑（micro_bs64 no-ckpt）。**待结果：part-MaxSim 重遮挡 mAP 能否破 exp324b 的 8.65 / 全部破 14.61 往 competitive 走。**【结果待填】

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21994:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4490:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1911:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt:62:2. fine-tune 阶段从 HR train image 在线生成 LR lattice variants。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21995:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4491:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1912:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt:63:3. 每张图每 iter 采样 `M=2-4` 个 lattice variants，周期性或 eval 用完整 `K=9`。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21996:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4492:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1915:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt:93:5. lattice variants 固定 K=9，主实验用 3x3 phase；bbox jitter/kernel variants 做 ablation，不要无限扩 K。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21997:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4493:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1920:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt:132:2. **vs-#false**：控制“多试几次总会撞上更好结果”的假象，可以用 shuffled lattice labels、非 lattice photometric variants、或 same-K random harmless variants。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21998:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4494:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1921:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt:136:VPFA 是最近最接近的强邻居。它把 CR-ReID 看成 feature space 中的 resolution direction，并用 Vector Panning 模块把 LR feature 映射到 pseudo-HR feature；论文还强调 SR 和 resolution-invariant 方法的瓶颈。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.00936)) 但它的 hidden variable 是“resolution gap / feature direction”，不是 sub-pixel sampling lattice，也不是对 lattice variants 做 marginalization。边界清楚，但必须正面对比。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21999:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4495:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1923:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt:140:RFD 处理 multi-resolution gallery，用 feature distillation/filtering 去掉 resolution-related feature。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.07871)) 它占了“resolution-invariant distillation”，但没有占 lattice intervention。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:22009:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4505:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2195:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4263:./reassess/r_3.md:3404:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/new_angle_AIRL.md:169:2. **头分化**: consistency 只读 f_rec(logits_rec/bn_feat_rec), f_full BNNeck/classifier 零 consistency **梯度**(smoke D4); clean f_rec 侧 detach(稳定目标)。**已知并接受的次要项(codex round-2 Medium)**: 退化 forward 是整模型 `model(deg_imgs)`(无 rec-only 路径), 故 f_full 的 frozen-bias BNNeck running mean/var 仍会"看到"退化 ground 图(仅统计跟踪, 非梯度泄漏)——与 `--airl` 单头路径完全一致(同一 degrade+forward 原语), 刻意保持对齐以保证消融诚实; 是否有实质影响由 kill-switch #4 训练结果裁决, 非 bug。若要彻底隔离需加 rec-only forward(改训练行为, 当前 lab-3090 正在跑此代码, 不动)。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:22011:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4507:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2300:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4377:./reassess/r_3.md:4101:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_codex_bundle/reviews/_verdicts.txt:169:  `full_map.detach()` 的位置足以切断梯度，但它发生在 f_full Swin late stages 和 `layer4` 已经执行之后。也就是说 degraded `rec_only` pass 仍计算了 f_full 激活并消耗随机层 RNG；只是这些结果不进 loss、不更新 f_full BNNeck/权重。这是注释“cheap / no f_full grad graph built”的夸大，不是梯度泄漏。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:22012:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4508:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2305:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4382:./reassess/r_3.md:4138:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_codex_bundle/reviews/codex_1.md:7276:../new_angle_AIRL.md:169:2. **头分化**: consistency 只读 f_rec(logits_rec/bn_feat_rec), f_full BNNeck/classifier 零 consistency **梯度**(smoke D4); clean f_rec 侧 detach(稳定目标)。**已知并接受的次要项(codex round-2 Medium)**: 退化 forward 是整模型 `model(deg_imgs)`(无 rec-only 路径), 故 f_full 的 frozen-bias BNNeck running mean/var 仍会"看到"退化 ground 图(仅统计跟踪, 非梯度泄漏)——与 `--airl` 单头路径完全一致(同一 degrade+forward 原语), 刻意保持对齐以保证消融诚实; 是否有实质影响由 kill-switch #4 训练结果裁决, 非 bug。若要彻底隔离需加 rec-only forward(改训练行为, 当前 lab-3090 正在跑此代码, 不动)。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:22043:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4539:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2578:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:14:Review the files experiments/cargo_cvpb/maxsim_probe.py and experiments/cargo_cvpb/afd_train.py (CARGO aerial-ground person ReID, empirical CVPB method). afd_train.py 含 --ovp 的 OVPMemory: 每pid维护aerial/ground两个EMA原型(buffer[num_pid,2,2048] momentum0.2), InfoNCE把样本拉到自己pid的opposite-view原型(τ0.05 λ0.5), total=CE+triplet+λ·OVP。逐行查: bug/runtime/shape/device/AMP数值安全; EMA更新+InfoNCE+cold-start mask正确性; train/test对称; --ovp off是否精确复现baseline。用web search查novelty撞车: opposite-view/cross-view EMA prototype + InfoNCE 在 aerial-ground 或 person ReID 的先例(查 PDPA 2025 CARGO / CMPC / MBCE VI-ReID)。输出 Verdict(approve/needs-attention)+ findings(severity Critical/High/Medium/Low)。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:22048:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4544:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2784:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3675:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:16:1. **训练动力学风险(High×2)**：早期 epoch OVP loss 会**结构性退化为零梯度**(冷启动稀疏 + 单列有效 → CE=0)，同时 `tau=0.05` 在随机原型上会给出**尖锐梯度尖峰**。两者叠加 → OVP 的 `meters['ovp']` 早期打印 ~0 不是收敛而是退化，监控会被误导，且 λ 早期实际不起作用。这不是 bug，但会让 kill-switch #2("ep10/20 ≥+1.0")的判读失真。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:22049:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4545:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2785:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3676:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:17:2. **novelty 撞车(High，方法稿层面)**：子代理联网查重判定 **likely-prior-art-collision**。"per-view identity EMA prototype + opposite-view InfoNCE"与 **CMPC(CVPR22)** 近乎逐字同构(只是 voice-face→aerial-ground、无监督→有监督)，且 **PDPA(2025, 同 CARGO)** 已占用"aerial-ground 上 prototype alignment"的命名与 framing。作为 empirical 涨点模块没问题；作为 headline 贡献过不了 novelty review。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:22050:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4546:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:2792:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:3683:experiments/cargo_cvpb/claude_review.md:63:- **建议**: 低成本加固——把导入改成显式包名(如建个 `__init__.py` 或用 `importlib` 按文件路径加载)，或在 README/run 命令处明确"必须 `cd cargo_cvpb && python3 afd_train.py`"。**当前文档命令安全**，故仅 Medium。

Sources: [VPFA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.00936), [LRAR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.13037), [RFD](https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.07871), [BlurPool](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.11486).

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:22237:experiments/exp356_pcmsc/codex_review.md:22:先例(Codex web search): PersonMAE(2311.04496)、MVP(2203.05175)、RILS(2301.06958)、RFCnet、MaskCLIP(2208.12262)。PC-MSC 差异化 = pose 部位选择 mask + 冻结 CLIP dense 区域语义目标 + 遮挡 ReID + 训练端正则的组合, 是 plausible distinct mechanism(非孤立"masked CLIP completion")。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:22559:DPEFormer 2024 已把真实遮挡物增强 ROA 做成模块，并在 ablation 里显示 ROA 明显强于 RE/CutPaste。FED、DPL-ReID、DPM++ 也都走真实/转移遮挡增强路线。PLBOA 和 ROA 都用真实物体，所以 +0.9 更像“打到下半身”而不是“真实纹理”。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_11.txt:28:廉价 kill-switch：还是零训练。  
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_4.txt:7:- 廉价 kill-switch：零训练可做。拿开源 VI checkpoint 或先训一个最小 baseline，在 SYSU/RegDB test split 中随机隐藏 20/50/80% 身份的 gallery 正样本，把对应 query 标成 absent。看 top-1 distance/margin 是否能区分 present vs absent；如果 AUROC 已经很高、FAR 很低，杀掉。若 re-ranking 提升 closed-set 却显著放大 absent false accept，这就是强证据。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_4.txt:17:- 廉价 kill-switch：零训练。只改 test IR 图像：`I -> 255-I`、gamma、CLAHE、直方图匹配；标签不变。测 R1/mAP drop 和 top-k 邻居 Jaccard。若 FDMNet/MFEN 等 frequency 方法已天然稳住，或 drop <2%，直接杀。若 drop 很大，说明 benchmark 隐藏了 sensor rendering shift。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_5.md:14:一个 ReID 团队找 CCF-B 方法稿。post-PRCV 的 frozen-image+on-disk 路已穷尽证负: 6 方向 cheap-kill 全死(B航拍不确定性/GOPL-SMPL可靠性/Gallery-Hubness/OSAC谱坍缩/RMA文本锚定/Rank-Regret效率)+视频no-go+Hubness诊断被 trivial 代理 #false-in-topk 证伪。**死区别推**: ①SMPL/人体几何对ReID无独特信号(四连证); ②遮挡ReID三墙(completion/occluder-gate/visibility); ③航拍-地面被VDT/GSAlign/ViSA/AG-VPReID占满; ④通用FM-import(MLLM/DINO/SD)赢SOTA已证负; ⑤frozen-image找accuracy隐藏变量被k-reciprocal/camera碾。资产: 强Swin/SOLIDER backbone + occluded_duke/market/MSMT/CARGO/AG-ReID.v2/RSTPReid数据 + 算力。**用户指令: 换问题/换ReID其他领域/换情况/主动构造特殊情况, 广撒网找新B类机会。** 铁律: ①问题或机制有新意(重定义'大家以为X其实Y'); ②有廉价(最好零训练frozen)kill-switch; ③联网查撞车不能是红海。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_5.md:20:找 1-2 个该领域/情况下能撑 CCF-B 方法稿的**具体机会**: 触发观察或失败 → 重定义(隐藏变量/新问题) → 机制草案 → **廉价kill-switch(最好零训练)** → 撞车核查(联网 2024-26, 不能红海)。诚实: 若该领域也红海/无廉价入口, 直说。每个机会给 verdict + 信心1-10 + 团队现有数据(market/MSMT/occluded_duke/CARGO/AG-ReID.v2/RSTPReid)能否首验还是需新数据。务实中文。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_5.md:22:我先按“2024-26 撞车核查”查最近的文本-图像 ReID 工作，重点看它们到底是在做 token/local alignment、LLM/CLIP、属性/噪声、还是检索协议问题。然后再反推哪些切口还有低成本 kill-switch。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_5.md:215:| 098-eq | PSG+GCN+PAA+PKP (KPR式prompting) | 60.9% | 72.8% | 84.5% | 88.5% | vs PAA: -0.7%/-1.4% | 🟡 Swin window attention 限制早期 pose 传播 |

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_1.md:97:廉价 kill-switch：零训练先做三件事。下载 VeRi-776 或 VERI-Wild annotations，用 frozen Swin/CLIP/DINO/已有 ReID checkpoint 跑 seen/unseen type split；统计 top-k false positives 中同 model/color/type 的比例；再做一个 test-time 语义原型惩罚或 subtraction。如果 unseen mAP 没有明显改善，或错误不集中在同车型同色假阳性，直接杀。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_1.md:112:廉价 kill-switch：零训练即可。用开源车牌 detector/OCR 在 VeRi-776/VERI-Wild 上生成三套评测：original、plate-masked、plate-only crop。用 frozen ReID/CLIP/DINO/Swin 特征直接算 mAP/R1。若 plate-only 有非随机检索能力，或 plate-masked 让 mAP 掉 3-5 点以上，且 OCR confidence/readability 与检索成功强相关，就值得推进；否则杀。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_1.md:130:廉价 kill-switch：零训练先做三件事。下载 VeRi-776 或 VERI-Wild annotations，用 frozen Swin/CLIP/DINO/已有 ReID checkpoint 跑 seen/unseen type split；统计 top-k false positives 中同 model/color/type 的比例；再做一个 test-time 语义原型惩罚或 subtraction。如果 unseen mAP 没有明显改善，或错误不集中在同车型同色假阳性，直接杀。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_10.md:88:- 零训练 kill-switch：用 frozen SOLIDER/exp030a 特征，按 query-camera 到 gallery-camera 的 train support 分桶，算 pair-conditioned mAP/R1；控制 positive 数量、gallery size、occlusion 后，tail-pair 比 head-pair 仍低 5-8 mAP 才继续。再跑一次 2025 camera-specific feature normalization 后 gap 仍在，才说明不是普通 camera bias。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.10195))
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_10.md:96:- 零训练 kill-switch：用 Market/MSMT/CARGO 构造 Zipf arrival stream，frozen 特征跑 nearest-centroid/global-threshold/DBSCAN/k-reciprocal baseline。看 false-merge 是否随 head support count 单调上升；再测一个 support-calibrated threshold 是否在相同 known-ID recall 下显著降 tail false merge。若全局阈值已解决，直接杀。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_10.md:107:- 零训练 kill-switch：用 frozen SOLIDER/exp030a 特征，按 query-camera 到 gallery-camera 的 train support 分桶，算 pair-conditioned mAP/R1；控制 positive 数量、gallery size、occlusion 后，tail-pair 比 head-pair 仍低 5-8 mAP 才继续。再跑一次 2025 camera-specific feature normalization 后 gap 仍在，才说明不是普通 camera bias。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.10195))

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_20.txt:1:按 2026-06-25 联网核查，我不建议再碰 open-world/DG、promptable bbox、航拍-地面、occluded cloth-changing：OWD 2024 已做 open-world benchmark，KPR 2024 已做 multi-person bbox ambiguity，AG-ReID.v2 已占航拍-地面，OC4-ReID 2024 已做遮挡+换衣组合。下面两个更像可构造的新协议。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_20.txt:10:**廉价 kill-switch**：
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_20.txt:16:**撞车核查**：老的 set-based ReID 确实处理过低质量/语义噪声图像集，但主要是视频/set 表征质量问题，不是“测试时弱 query bag、未知目标纯度、多假设检索”协议；2019 ID-aware Quality 还明确以 set-to-set 和质量权重为核心。KPR 2024 处理的是同一 bbox 多人歧义，不是跨图片 query-bag 污染。  
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_20.txt:26:**廉价 kill-switch**：
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_20.txt:36:优先级：先做 **机会 1**，因为它最 ReID-native、零训练 kill-switch 最便宜；第二台机器可以并行跑 **机会 2** 的泄漏诊断和闭式 projection。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_4.md:14:一个 ReID 团队找 CCF-B 方法稿。post-PRCV 的 frozen-image+on-disk 路已穷尽证负: 6 方向 cheap-kill 全死(B航拍不确定性/GOPL-SMPL可靠性/Gallery-Hubness/OSAC谱坍缩/RMA文本锚定/Rank-Regret效率)+视频no-go+Hubness诊断被 trivial 代理 #false-in-topk 证伪。**死区别推**: ①SMPL/人体几何对ReID无独特信号(四连证); ②遮挡ReID三墙(completion/occluder-gate/visibility); ③航拍-地面被VDT/GSAlign/ViSA/AG-VPReID占满; ④通用FM-import(MLLM/DINO/SD)赢SOTA已证负; ⑤frozen-image找accuracy隐藏变量被k-reciprocal/camera碾。资产: 强Swin/SOLIDER backbone + occluded_duke/market/MSMT/CARGO/AG-ReID.v2/RSTPReid数据 + 算力。**用户指令: 换问题/换ReID其他领域/换情况/主动构造特殊情况, 广撒网找新B类机会。** 铁律: ①问题或机制有新意(重定义'大家以为X其实Y'); ②有廉价(最好零训练frozen)kill-switch; ③联网查撞车不能是红海。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_4.md:20:找 1-2 个该领域/情况下能撑 CCF-B 方法稿的**具体机会**: 触发观察或失败 → 重定义(隐藏变量/新问题) → 机制草案 → **廉价kill-switch(最好零训练)** → 撞车核查(联网 2024-26, 不能红海)。诚实: 若该领域也红海/无廉价入口, 直说。每个机会给 verdict + 信心1-10 + 团队现有数据(market/MSMT/occluded_duke/CARGO/AG-ReID.v2/RSTPReid)能否首验还是需新数据。务实中文。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_4.md:86:- 廉价 kill-switch：零训练可做。拿开源 VI checkpoint 或先训一个最小 baseline，在 SYSU/RegDB test split 中随机隐藏 20/50/80% 身份的 gallery 正样本，把对应 query 标成 absent。看 top-1 distance/margin 是否能区分 present vs absent；如果 AUROC 已经很高、FAR 很低，杀掉。若 re-ranking 提升 closed-set 却显著放大 absent false accept，这就是强证据。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_4.md:96:- 廉价 kill-switch：零训练。只改 test IR 图像：`I -> 255-I`、gamma、CLAHE、直方图匹配；标签不变。测 R1/mAP drop 和 top-k 邻居 Jaccard。若 FDMNet/MFEN 等 frequency 方法已天然稳住，或 drop <2%，直接杀。若 drop 很大，说明 benchmark 隐藏了 sensor rendering shift。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_4.md:111:- 廉价 kill-switch：零训练可做。拿开源 VI checkpoint 或先训一个最小 baseline，在 SYSU/RegDB test split 中随机隐藏 20/50/80% 身份的 gallery 正样本，把对应 query 标成 absent。看 top-1 distance/margin 是否能区分 present vs absent；如果 AUROC 已经很高、FAR 很低，杀掉。若 re-ranking 提升 closed-set 却显著放大 absent false accept，这就是强证据。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_20.md:882:- 今晚数据驱动地证负了一整类 **in-domain 特征机制**（burstiness/backdoor/TopoFR/UCE/FM-import）：frozen 看着有戏，ReID 训练后被吸收，**连弱 baseline 也吸收**。frozen kill-switch 会骗人。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_20.md:933:- 最近 cousin = OGFR (arXiv:2507.08520, 2025) 只做 occluder **类型** held-out（1-D），**无人做 2-D (类×部位) 组合 split + group-DRO**。`"compositional" occluder "body part"` / `group-DRO + reid + occlusion` web 搜零直接命中。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/d_20.md:941:- kill-switch 设计成功：训练判据(非frozen)便宜判死。ERM 续 e40 确认 gap 稳定。

# FGEU Realizability Kill-Switch — 结果 (DEAD 3/10, 撞 exp109 query-side 墙)

**日期**: 2026-06-25
**脚本**: `experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_realizability_killswitch.py`
**机器**: lab-3090-d (frozen + numpy, 无 backward, 无训练)
**ckpt**: `log/occluded_posetrack/exp266b_best_b_op_s41_3090/transformer_120.pth` (vs-KPR posetrack 实验, in-domain mAP 78.5/R1 86.2)
**数据**: occluded_posetrack_reid (有 tracklet/帧信息), feature dim=8192 (equal_concat)
**log**: lab-3090 `/tmp/realiz_smoke.log`, feature cache `/tmp/realiz_posetrack_feats.npz`

---

## 一句话结论

**realizable 同 camera tracklet union 只拿到 16.3% 的 oracle 恢复 (远低于 40% 门槛), 且只比免费 k-reciprocal 强 ~2.3x。FGEU 撞 exp109 query-side 墙 — 大 headroom 只存在于部署不可得的 cross-camera 同 ID 证据里, realizable 的同机位多帧拿不到。判 DEAD 3/10。**

random 异 ID 控制完美砸毁 (-28.86), 证明对照设置可信。

---

## 关键事实: posetrack tracklet 结构 (生死前提)

- 命名 `pid_cVID_TIMESTAMP.jpg`, **同 pid + 同 cVID = 同 video/tracklet (一个机位连续帧) = realizable**。
- ⚠️ repo 的 posetrack loader 给每张图分配**逐图唯一 camid** (junk filter 是 no-op, KPR mot_inter_intra_video 协议)。所以缓存的 cam **不是** tracklet id, 必须从**文件名 c{VID}** 重建 tracklet。脚本已正确处理。
- query 1439 个 tracklet, 帧数分布 `{1帧: 297, 2帧: 1142}` — **每 tracklet 最多 2 帧** (realizable 预算 B=2)。
- cross-video oracle 稀薄: 仅 **147/1379** query pid 在 gallery 有不同 video_id 的同 ID 图 (posetrack gallery 大量是同 video 帧, 与 Occluded-Duke 的跨相机 gallery 性质不同)。

## SANITY

- frozen 全 query mAP = **78.43** (in-domain train log 报 78.5, 完全对上 → ckpt 加载正确, 用的是真训练 eval 特征)。
- 单帧 (每 tracklet 取第一帧) mAP = 78.04。
- 失败子集 = 单帧 AP bottom-50% = 720 tracklet (mean AP 56.6), 其中 568 个有 ≥1 realizable 同 video 额外帧。

---

## 核心生死对照 (n=568 realizable-failure tracklet; oracle 可用 90 个)

| arm | AP | dAP | 部署性 |
|-----|-----|-----|--------|
| baseline 单帧 | 57.73 | — | — |
| **A_realizable** 同 video union (MEAN) | 65.30 | **+7.57** | ✅ 部署可得 |
| A_realizable 同 video union (MAX) | 65.24 | +7.51 | ✅ |
| **B_oracle** cross-video gallery union | 76.58 | **+26.77** | ❌ 部署不可得 (exp109 上界) |
| **C_rand** 随机异 ID union | 28.87 | **-28.86** | 控制 — 必须砸毁 ✅ |
| C k-reciprocal (单帧免费 re-rank) | 61.00 | +3.27 | ✅ 免费, 无新证据 |

**apples-to-apples (90 个 oracle 可用 tracklet, 同一子集):**
- dAP realizable-MEAN = **+4.38** vs dAP oracle = **+26.77**
- **Recovery_realizable / Recovery_oracle = 16.3% (MEAN) / 15.6% (MAX)** ← 远低于 40% 门槛
- recovery-rate (dAP>+0.05): realizable **0.366**, oracle **0.911**, random **0.000**

**fragility gate (只融弱 support 失败 vs 全融):**
- fuse-ALL dAP = +7.57 (n=568)
- fuse-FRAGILE-only (bottom-50% support) dAP = +5.51 (n=45)
- non-fragile dAP = +3.24 (n=45)
- gate 方向对 (fragile > non-fragile), 但绝对量级小, 救不回 oracle gap。

---

## 诚实解读 (不粉饰)

1. **realizable 信号是真的, 但小**: 同机位第二帧 union 在宽失败集上 +7.57, 确实 >免费 k-reciprocal +3.27 (~2.3x)。所以"多帧 union 有效"这一点成立, 不是 0。
2. **但远够不到 headroom**: 在能直接和 oracle 比的 90 个 tracklet 上, realizable 只恢复 oracle 的 **16.3%**。大 headroom (oracle +26.77, 91% query 被救) 来自**跨 video / 跨机位的同 ID 证据**, 而那正是部署不可得的 (= exp109 墙)。
3. **为什么**: 同一机位连续两帧高度冗余 (同视角、同光照、相邻时刻, 遮挡常常一样), 提供的**新身份证据**很少; 真正能救遮挡 query 的是另一个机位/视角的同 ID 图, 但那需要身份标签才能取 (oracle)。
4. **posetrack 协议的额外不利**: 这个 benchmark 的 gallery 以同 video 帧为主, cross-video oracle 本身就稀薄 (147 pid), oracle 可用子集只有 90 — 比例估计有噪声, 但方向极其清楚 (16% vs 40% 门槛, recovery-rate 0.37 vs 0.91 差距巨大)。

---

## 鲁棒性复核 (bottom-30% 更严失败定义, reuse 缓存特征)

换更"真遮挡"的失败子集 (单帧 AP bottom-30%, n=336, base 仅 39.56) 重跑, 结论不变:

| arm | dAP | 比例 |
|-----|-----|------|
| A_realizable 同 video MEAN | +12.72 | — |
| B_oracle cross-video | +32.09 | — |
| C_rand 随机异 ID | -21.93 | 砸毁 ✅ |
| k-reciprocal | +1.97 | — |
| **Recovery_realizable/oracle (65 oracle 子集)** | — | **16.5%** |
| recovery-rate | realizable 0.467 / oracle 0.938 / random 0.000 | — |

ratio 从 bottom-50% 的 16.3% → bottom-30% 的 **16.5%**, 纹丝不动。注意越难的 query realizable 绝对增益越大 (+12.72, 比 k-recip 强 6.5x), 但 oracle 同步放大 (+32.09), **headroom-realizable 的差是结构性的, 不是阈值噪声**。比例 pin 在 ~16% = realizable 永远只能恢复约 1/6 的 cross-camera 证据 headroom。

---

## VERDICT

**DEAD 3/10 — exp109 query-side 墙。**

realizable 同 camera tracklet union 拿不到 ≥40% 的 oracle 恢复 (只有 16.3%)。FGEU 的大 headroom 是 cross-camera 同 ID 证据 (oracle, 部署不可得) 独有的, realizable 的同机位多帧复制不了。这正是 query-side oracle 变体, 撞 exp109 墙。

**不推进 FGEU 作为方法稿。** 若仍想要 multi-frame ReID 的角度, 残存的 +7.57 realizable 增益只能当一个 test-time trick / set-based ReID 的小补充, 撑不起 B 类方法稿 (且 set-based ReID + UFFM/AMC 已占满该位, 见 evidence_method_design.txt 撞车核查)。
