experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:1765:experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:9:exp260b 已有 OA-SD（occluded student ↔ clean EMA teacher 双前向）+ PLBOA（下肢遮挡增广），但其蒸馏只作用在 **pooled global 特征**（cosine）。BT-PKD 进一步蒸馏 per-keypoint 特征**方向**（cosine），仍是「让被遮挡 token 的特征向 clean token 看齐」。两者都没有触碰探针指认的真正病灶：**被遮挡 per-part token 的归一化统计（一阶/二阶矩）整体漂移到一个可分离的子空间**——这是一条「有/无遮挡」的 domain 轴，叠加在身份信号上。OA-SD/BT-PKD 把个体特征拉近，但没有显式消掉这条 domain 轴；探针显示这条轴在跨域时大量残留（pre-GCN AUC 0.97），GCN 只部分修复。

experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:2121:experiments/decisions.md:1491:- 🔴 红队（方案 A）核心论点: SGMKC 实现成本极低（~15 行代码，无新参数），属于不同类别的改进（训练方法论 vs 架构/loss 添加），skeleton graph + masked prediction 组合是真正新颖的（FCFormer 用 transformer decoder，MAE 用 random patches，没有人在 skeleton graph 上做过 masked completion for ReID）。47 个失败实验都是架构添加或 loss 变体，SGMKC 是 self-supervised 训练策略——不同搜索空间。即使失败，负面结论也有论文价值。信心: 6/10
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:2122:experiments/decisions.md:1492:- 🔵 蓝队（方案 B）核心论点: 47 个实验中 21/21 训练端改进全部失败，贝叶斯后验 P(失败) ≈ 95.7%。CLAUDE.md 明确说"不要做 GCN 小变体"。SkeletonMAE (2023) 已在动作识别上做过 skeleton graph masked autoencoding，novelty 受限。即使涨 1%，"在 GCN 上加 MAE 辅助任务"的 story 不够支撑 B 会。应该花时间精读 2024-2025 新工作（uncertainty-aware ReID、diffusion-based augmentation 等），找到 paradigm shift 级别的创新。信心: 8/10
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:2123:experiments/decisions.md:1499:5. 但我认同蓝队的核心判断：SGMKC 更可能是 supporting experiment 而非 main contribution

experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3148:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_4.md:507:**用户关键纠正（记忆 fair-baseline-not-solider）**：为什么 SOLIDER 强主干成了否决一切的理由？全 B 类语料没人用 SOLIDER/Swin 当基线，我们自定一个全场最强、没人用的基线再否决所有方案，本末倒置、自我否决。两个真错误：(1) 我把"强主干吸收 nuisance"过度泛化成对整个鲁棒性簇的判决；(2) 用便宜探针代替真训练去否决（用户反复说的"别只probe判负、要真训练"）。
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3149:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_4.md:509:**纠正后的操作原则**：门槛=同行用的标准基线（ViT-base，我们手上 PRCC 43.0/Market 86.8/Occ-Duke 53.3/LTCC），公平对标已发表 B 类数字；不再要求打赢 SOLIDER（SOLIDER 只做附加 scale 验证）；验证用真训练三种子，探针只排优先级不一票否决。据此**重开**被基线假象/探针假象误杀的方向。
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3150:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_4.md:511:重判已出（reopen_under_fair_baseline-codex.md）：重开 3 方向（exp024 无姿态结构在标准 ViT-base 已有 +2.2~2.7 rank1 真信号被 SOLIDER 尺子误埋 / PARTIAL_EVIDENCE / 换衣稳定证据）；C 类真死保持（OC4超加性=数据属性、exp022贴图检测器、与CAL/CCIL/instance-wise同质）。
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3153:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_4.md:557:- C 特权信息蒸馏: 已完成,见 experiments/paper_materials/newinfo_privileged_distill-codex.md。结论是普通pose/parsing/silhouette teacher 已被 PGFL-KD、π-VL、FLAG、AOANet等占住,且 SOLIDER 已含 parsing 能力; 最值得继续探的是 3D体型+dense correspondence 残差蒸馏,其次是有视频数据时的3D skeleton/gait relation,parsing只适合作负控。
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3154:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_4.md:653:- **exp016 换衣判决（Tiny seed0 两数据集）**：LTCC 换衣 12.3/24.7、PRCC 换衣 40.1/42.4（同衣 98.2/99.5 饱和），全面大幅低于发表水位。结论：SOLIDER 人本预训练放大衣服捷径，换衣降级为分析素材（与遮挡战场形成干净对照）。协议照搬 Simple-CCReID、读取器对账 PASS、两条评测路径数字一致。
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3155:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_4.md:654:- **exp017 探针放行候选 A**：SOLIDER 特征对 CLIP 遮挡物语义零线性解码（R²=-0.01）、嵌入级超锥零假设解释力仅约 26%、残差与 AP 相关 -0.164（控 s_top1 后 -0.097 贴线）。按预注册中间地带规则的属性级判据放行。
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3156:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_4.md:670:阅读已完成：167 篇全覆盖。38 篇范围内精读 + 88 篇范围外粗读由 codex 完成（笔记 paper_notes/notes/in_*.md、out_*.md），剩 41 篇因 codex 额度耗尽（2026-06-11 13:01 恢复）由 Claude 摘要级补读（missing_41_skim_by_claude.md）。元分析和候选方向写在 **paper_notes/SYNTHESIS.md**，要点：(1) 在"单 embedding、测试无额外输入"口径下我们的 SOLIDER Swin-Small 纯基线 66.5 已处于已发表 B 类遮挡工作头部（发表水位 57.8-65.5，仅 arXiv 的 DPL-ReID 67.2 和测试期多部件距离的 AOANet 70.6 更高）；(2) 模块类增益=弱基线假象（这批论文内部基线 48-53 起步），反向验证我们 13 个判负；(3) 站得住的增益全部来自训练期新信息源（VLM 语义/外部遮挡物数据/生成数据/分布先验）；(4) 空白=遮挡结构化 VLM 语义当纯训练期监督蒸馏进非 CLIP 强人本主干、测试回纯单 embedding，没人做过。候选 A=该语义蒸馏方向（先零训练探针：冻结 SOLIDER 特征能否线性解码 CLIP 属性/遮挡物标签，解码不出的残差是否关联检索错误）；候选 B=真实遮挡物数据源+分布先验（最便宜，A 的对照轴）；候选 C=干净到遮挡的结构保持蒸馏（中风险排队）；候选 D=可靠检索稿保底投 PRCV。待办：codex 额度恢复后对候选 A 做独立新颖性红队，然后交用户挑方向。未开任何实验。
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3241:experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_gallery_killswitch.py:625:# TEST C — SINGLETON MERGE (Zipf gallery, tail false-merge vs head support)
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3286:experiments/cargo_cvpb/monitor.md:137:- **★★★ 战略结论(2026-06-23)**: **两个涨点机制(OVC-SetVLAD 角度2 + ACVP 角度6)全失败 → resnet50 + 现有 OVLI loss 框架内"再加一个涨点模块"这条路走完。** headline 定为 **OVLI 52.37 单机制 + 4 个干净消融**(setpool/allview/α sweep + OVP 对照),5-codex 评 B 类可行。**下一步换思路: Swin/SOLIDER 强 backbone 冲 SOTA**(弱 resnet50 都 52.37 超 VDT 42.76,强 backbone 应上台阶)→ AG-ReID.v2 跨数据集 → paper 骨架。

experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3494:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:1963:./reviews/deep_18.md:7298:4. **证据闭环**：关键不是总表，而是消融。CE 到 CE+CM 后，RegDB V2I Rank-1 从 59.0 到 88.0，SYSU all-search 从 56.5 到 67.1，证明 meta metric 本身有效。加 SMR 后 RegDB 从 88.0 到 94.1，证明双向一致性有用。去掉 shuffling 后 RegDB 只有 89.3，加回后到 94.1，SYSU 从 63.6 到 68.6，说明“全样本轮流 query-support”不是装饰。MM 的收益较小，更多证明 memory 是辅助增强。

experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3500:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:2155:./ondisk_pivot.md:4402:./reassess/r_3.md:4487:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:45:"mechanism": "FLaN-Net builds a CLIP-based pipeline that constructs an occlusion-aware fine-grained textual prompt \"A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*],\" where three categorical pseudo-word tokens are learned by textual inversion from the image: S* (subject/identity description), A* (visible attributes), and O* (the occluding object). A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3504:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:2163:./ondisk_pivot.md:4652:./reassess/r_3.md:7999:./reassess/r_3.md:4487:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:45:"mechanism": "FLaN-Net builds a CLIP-based pipeline that constructs an occlusion-aware fine-grained textual prompt \"A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*],\" where three categorical pseudo-word tokens are learned by textual inversion from the image: S* (subject/identity description), A* (visible attributes), and O* (the occluding object). A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",

experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3542:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5549:./reassess/r_2.md:1263:reassess/r_3.md:2822:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:654:./analyses/deep_25.txt:35:4. **证据闭环**：最强闭环是“换辅助模态”消融。dense correspondence embeddings 全面超过 2D keypoints、silhouettes、part segmentation、3D skeletons、point clouds、SMPL parameters，证明重定义的“稠密对齐表示比稀疏参数更适合”是对的。组件表里，appearance baseline 在 VCCR CC 是 49.7 rank-1、40.2 mAP，完整方法到 59.8、48.6；CCVID 从 80.9、75.3 到 93.9、91.2。MRIE 相比简单融合带来大幅提升，说明不是单纯 gait 分支有效，而是 gait-appearance interaction 有价值。ECS、PCA 可视化、t-SNE 和激活图进一步证明 dense correspondence embedding 稳定，3D gait 比 SMPL 参数更成簇，融合后类间更清楚。

experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3561:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5568:./reassess/r_2.md:1876:reassess/r_3.md:4271:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_codex_bundle/reviews/codex_4.md:21478:../airl_related_work.md:26:RAR 用 query resolution **动态路由**选子空间。AIRL **不路由**——#3 oracle 实测硬路由(area/reliability 阈值)失败(≤+0.41),**软固定先验融合**(w=0.25,clean+recover 两证据头)反而 +1.46。所以 AIRL 的 claim 必须是 "fixed-prior fusion of clean/recover evidence heads under an observation-limited ceiling",**绝不吹成 query-budget routing**(那既撞 RAR 又与实现不符)。
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3562:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5569:./reassess/r_2.md:1917:reassess/r_3.md:4487:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:45:"mechanism": "FLaN-Net builds a CLIP-based pipeline that constructs an occlusion-aware fine-grained textual prompt \"A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*],\" where three categorical pseudo-word tokens are learned by textual inversion from the image: S* (subject/identity description), A* (visible attributes), and O* (the occluding object). A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3563:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5570:./reassess/r_2.md:1918:reassess/r_3.md:4490:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:78:"transfer_to_occluded": "Recast the occluder as a confounder and apply the same backdoor-adjustment recipe: build an \"Occluder Dictionary\" of occlusion patterns/regions stored as Gaussians with priors P(occluder), then train with P(Y|do(X))=Σ_occluder P(Y|X,occluder)·P(occluder), marginalizing over occluders so the model cannot exploit occluder-identity spurious correlations (e.g. a particular bicycle/car/pole co-occurring with certain galleries or cameras). Two concretely transferable tricks: (1) the reverse-attention masking that isolates the confounder feature from the identity feature map — directly usable to separate occluder-region features from body features without external segmentation; (2) representing each confounder as a sampled Gaussian rather than a stored feature, giving cheap synthetic occluder augmentation at the feature level. The NWGM trick keeps the marginalization a single classification, so it's nearly free at training time and zero-cost at inference.",
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3564:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5571:./reassess/r_2.md:1922:reassess/r_3.md:4495:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:110:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas (the paper IS occluded ReID, so these are native): (1) The attention-magnitude saliency for foreground/background separation — derive a per-patch foreground probability from a lightweight conv-sigmoid head trained ONLY by a foreground-background contrastive loss (no pose/parsing labels), then suppress occluder/background tokens; this is an external-prior-free occluder gate, attractive because pose estimators fail under occlusion. (2) The importance-ranked cumulative fusion (FHFM): rank patches by CLS-attention*norm and let high-confidence (likely visible) patches contribute to every fusion level while low-importance (likely occluded) patches contribute least — a soft, label-free visibility weighting that downweights corrupted regions without a hard mask. The region-restricted masked attention with learnable part tokens is also a clean parsing-free way to get part features robust to missing regions.",
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3565:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5572:./reassess/r_2.md:1924:reassess/r_3.md:4497:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:126:"transfer_to_occluded": "The Intersection-Alignment Score (IAS) explainable re-ranking is directly occlusion-relevant: compute IoU between the model's activation/attention map and a visible-region (non-occluded) mask, plus a cosine alignment between query and gallery activation maps, then refine the distance matrix — multiply distance by alpha<1 when attention focuses on visible regions AND query/gallery attentions agree, and by beta>1 when attention falls on occluded/missing regions. In occluded ReID this is a self-supervised matching-side trust mechanism: down-weight matches whose discriminative evidence sits on occluder/missing pixels and reward query-gallery pairs whose visible-region attention co-aligns, without needing identity-level supervision. The canonical-UV idea (mapping body regions to fixed coordinates so the same part always aligns) is also a clean way to make two partially-occluded crops compare only on their commonly-visible parts.",
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3566:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5573:./reassess/r_2.md:1925:reassess/r_3.md:4498:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:127:"novel_component": "Intersection-Alignment Score (IAS): turning an explainability signal into a re-ranking operator — measure how much the model's attention overlaps the visible-body mask (IoU) and how mutually consistent query/gallery attention maps are, then asymmetrically shrink or inflate pairwise distances. It makes \"is the model looking at occluded regions?\" a concrete, label-free matching correction rather than a post-hoc visualization.",
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3571:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5641:./reassess/r_2.md:4091:reassess/r_2.md:811:analyses/deep_18.txt:8:4. **证据闭环**：关键不是总表，而是消融。CE 到 CE+CM 后，RegDB V2I Rank-1 从 59.0 到 88.0，SYSU all-search 从 56.5 到 67.1，证明 meta metric 本身有效。加 SMR 后 RegDB 从 88.0 到 94.1，证明双向一致性有用。去掉 shuffling 后 RegDB 只有 89.3，加回后到 94.1，SYSU 从 63.6 到 68.6，说明“全样本轮流 query-support”不是装饰。MM 的收益较小，更多证明 memory 是辅助增强。

experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3600:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5694:./reassess/r_2.md:5830:reassess/r_3.md:8002:./reassess/r_3.md:4490:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:78:"transfer_to_occluded": "Recast the occluder as a confounder and apply the same backdoor-adjustment recipe: build an \"Occluder Dictionary\" of occlusion patterns/regions stored as Gaussians with priors P(occluder), then train with P(Y|do(X))=Σ_occluder P(Y|X,occluder)·P(occluder), marginalizing over occluders so the model cannot exploit occluder-identity spurious correlations (e.g. a particular bicycle/car/pole co-occurring with certain galleries or cameras). Two concretely transferable tricks: (1) the reverse-attention masking that isolates the confounder feature from the identity feature map — directly usable to separate occluder-region features from body features without external segmentation; (2) representing each confounder as a sampled Gaussian rather than a stored feature, giving cheap synthetic occluder augmentation at the feature level. The NWGM trick keeps the marginalization a single classification, so it's nearly free at training time and zero-cost at inference.",
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3601:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5695:./reassess/r_2.md:5832:reassess/r_3.md:8009:./reassess/r_3.md:4497:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:126:"transfer_to_occluded": "The Intersection-Alignment Score (IAS) explainable re-ranking is directly occlusion-relevant: compute IoU between the model's activation/attention map and a visible-region (non-occluded) mask, plus a cosine alignment between query and gallery activation maps, then refine the distance matrix — multiply distance by alpha<1 when attention focuses on visible regions AND query/gallery attentions agree, and by beta>1 when attention falls on occluded/missing regions. In occluded ReID this is a self-supervised matching-side trust mechanism: down-weight matches whose discriminative evidence sits on occluder/missing pixels and reward query-gallery pairs whose visible-region attention co-aligns, without needing identity-level supervision. The canonical-UV idea (mapping body regions to fixed coordinates so the same part always aligns) is also a clean way to make two partially-occluded crops compare only on their commonly-visible parts.",
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3615:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5756:./reassess/r_3.md:2501:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_24.md:991:**方向（用户决策#33=选项1）**：放开 SOLIDER 强主干，回常规 ImageNet 预训练主干(TransReID ViT-base、ImageNet 预训练 Swin-Tiny)刷标准遮挡 ReID mAP/rank1。可靠性/conformal 线归档(决策#28-#32 的负结果+诊断作分析素材)。

experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3626:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5767:./reassess/r_3.md:2822:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:654:./analyses/deep_25.txt:35:4. **证据闭环**：最强闭环是“换辅助模态”消融。dense correspondence embeddings 全面超过 2D keypoints、silhouettes、part segmentation、3D skeletons、point clouds、SMPL parameters，证明重定义的“稠密对齐表示比稀疏参数更适合”是对的。组件表里，appearance baseline 在 VCCR CC 是 49.7 rank-1、40.2 mAP，完整方法到 59.8、48.6；CCVID 从 80.9、75.3 到 93.9、91.2。MRIE 相比简单融合带来大幅提升，说明不是单纯 gait 分支有效，而是 gait-appearance interaction 有价值。ECS、PCA 可视化、t-SNE 和激活图进一步证明 dense correspondence embedding 稳定，3D gait 比 SMPL 参数更成簇，融合后类间更清楚。

experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3669:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5810:./reassess/r_3.md:4271:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_codex_bundle/reviews/codex_4.md:21478:../airl_related_work.md:26:RAR 用 query resolution **动态路由**选子空间。AIRL **不路由**——#3 oracle 实测硬路由(area/reliability 阈值)失败(≤+0.41),**软固定先验融合**(w=0.25,clean+recover 两证据头)反而 +1.46。所以 AIRL 的 claim 必须是 "fixed-prior fusion of clean/recover evidence heads under an observation-limited ceiling",**绝不吹成 query-budget routing**(那既撞 RAR 又与实现不符)。
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3675:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5816:./reassess/r_3.md:4487:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:45:"mechanism": "FLaN-Net builds a CLIP-based pipeline that constructs an occlusion-aware fine-grained textual prompt \"A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*],\" where three categorical pseudo-word tokens are learned by textual inversion from the image: S* (subject/identity description), A* (visible attributes), and O* (the occluding object). A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3676:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5817:./reassess/r_3.md:4490:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:78:"transfer_to_occluded": "Recast the occluder as a confounder and apply the same backdoor-adjustment recipe: build an \"Occluder Dictionary\" of occlusion patterns/regions stored as Gaussians with priors P(occluder), then train with P(Y|do(X))=Σ_occluder P(Y|X,occluder)·P(occluder), marginalizing over occluders so the model cannot exploit occluder-identity spurious correlations (e.g. a particular bicycle/car/pole co-occurring with certain galleries or cameras). Two concretely transferable tricks: (1) the reverse-attention masking that isolates the confounder feature from the identity feature map — directly usable to separate occluder-region features from body features without external segmentation; (2) representing each confounder as a sampled Gaussian rather than a stored feature, giving cheap synthetic occluder augmentation at the feature level. The NWGM trick keeps the marginalization a single classification, so it's nearly free at training time and zero-cost at inference.",
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3677:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5818:./reassess/r_3.md:4495:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:110:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas (the paper IS occluded ReID, so these are native): (1) The attention-magnitude saliency for foreground/background separation — derive a per-patch foreground probability from a lightweight conv-sigmoid head trained ONLY by a foreground-background contrastive loss (no pose/parsing labels), then suppress occluder/background tokens; this is an external-prior-free occluder gate, attractive because pose estimators fail under occlusion. (2) The importance-ranked cumulative fusion (FHFM): rank patches by CLS-attention*norm and let high-confidence (likely visible) patches contribute to every fusion level while low-importance (likely occluded) patches contribute least — a soft, label-free visibility weighting that downweights corrupted regions without a hard mask. The region-restricted masked attention with learnable part tokens is also a clean parsing-free way to get part features robust to missing regions.",
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3678:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5819:./reassess/r_3.md:4497:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:126:"transfer_to_occluded": "The Intersection-Alignment Score (IAS) explainable re-ranking is directly occlusion-relevant: compute IoU between the model's activation/attention map and a visible-region (non-occluded) mask, plus a cosine alignment between query and gallery activation maps, then refine the distance matrix — multiply distance by alpha<1 when attention focuses on visible regions AND query/gallery attentions agree, and by beta>1 when attention falls on occluded/missing regions. In occluded ReID this is a self-supervised matching-side trust mechanism: down-weight matches whose discriminative evidence sits on occluder/missing pixels and reward query-gallery pairs whose visible-region attention co-aligns, without needing identity-level supervision. The canonical-UV idea (mapping body regions to fixed coordinates so the same part always aligns) is also a clean way to make two partially-occluded crops compare only on their commonly-visible parts.",
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3679:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5820:./reassess/r_3.md:4498:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:127:"novel_component": "Intersection-Alignment Score (IAS): turning an explainability signal into a re-ranking operator — measure how much the model's attention overlaps the visible-body mask (IoU) and how mutually consistent query/gallery attention maps are, then asymmetrically shrink or inflate pairwise distances. It makes \"is the model looking at occluded regions?\" a concrete, label-free matching correction rather than a post-hoc visualization.",
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3685:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5826:./reassess/r_3.md:4696:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:58:**执行计划**：exp324f agent 正在 lab-4090 算 Swin distmat → 它一落地我立刻跑 #1 oracle（0-GPU）。正向 → #2 re-rank（training-free 主表素材）。OT 线(#3)等某 GPU 空了上。

The NWGM trick keeps the marginalization a single classification, so it's nearly free at training time and zero-cost at inference.",
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3709:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5940:./reassess/r_3.md:8007:./reassess/r_3.md:4495:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:110:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas (the paper IS occluded ReID, so these are native): (1) The attention-magnitude saliency for foreground/background separation — derive a per-patch foreground probability from a lightweight conv-sigmoid head trained ONLY by a foreground-background contrastive loss (no pose/parsing labels), then suppress occluder/background tokens; this is an external-prior-free occluder gate, attractive because pose estimators fail under occlusion. (2) The importance-ranked cumulative fusion (FHFM): rank patches by CLS-attention*norm and let high-confidence (likely visible) patches contribute to every fusion level while low-importance (likely occluded) patches contribute least — a soft, label-free visibility weighting that downweights corrupted regions without a hard mask. The region-restricted masked attention with learnable part tokens is also a clean parsing-free way to get part features robust to missing regions.",
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3710:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5941:./reassess/r_3.md:8009:./reassess/r_3.md:4497:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:126:"transfer_to_occluded": "The Intersection-Alignment Score (IAS) explainable re-ranking is directly occlusion-relevant: compute IoU between the model's activation/attention map and a visible-region (non-occluded) mask, plus a cosine alignment between query and gallery activation maps, then refine the distance matrix — multiply distance by alpha<1 when attention focuses on visible regions AND query/gallery attentions agree, and by beta>1 when attention falls on occluded/missing regions. In occluded ReID this is a self-supervised matching-side trust mechanism: down-weight matches whose discriminative evidence sits on occluder/missing pixels and reward query-gallery pairs whose visible-region attention co-aligns, without needing identity-level supervision. The canonical-UV idea (mapping body regions to fixed coordinates so the same part always aligns) is also a clean way to make two partially-occluded crops compare only on their commonly-visible parts.",
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3713:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5953:./reassess/r_3.md:8374:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/decisions.md:1576:- 🔵 蓝队（方案 B: PPE）核心论点: 重新定义遮挡问题（从 visibility mask 到 uncertainty quantification），pose confidence → feature uncertainty 的因果链是全新机制。论文理论深度更强（概率嵌入+信息几何）。与 PSG 正交互补（PSG 管特征提取，PPE 管匹配）。P3E/DUL 已验证概率嵌入在 ReID 中可训练。攻击 A: PAB 已在同范式失败（attention bias 变体），CLAUDE.md 警告"attention trick"，2.8K 参数太小难以撑论文主贡献，12x4 分辨率太粗糙。信心: 7/10
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3795:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_17.md:279:**用户关键纠正（记忆 fair-baseline-not-solider）**：为什么 SOLIDER 强主干成了否决一切的理由？全 B 类语料没人用 SOLIDER/Swin 当基线，我们自定一个全场最强、没人用的基线再否决所有方案，本末倒置、自我否决。两个真错误：(1) 我把"强主干吸收 nuisance"过度泛化成对整个鲁棒性簇的判决；(2) 用便宜探针代替真训练去否决（用户反复说的"别只probe判负、要真训练"）。
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3796:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_17.md:281:**纠正后的操作原则**：门槛=同行用的标准基线（ViT-base，我们手上 PRCC 43.0/Market 86.8/Occ-Duke 53.3/LTCC），公平对标已发表 B 类数字；不再要求打赢 SOLIDER（SOLIDER 只做附加 scale 验证）；验证用真训练三种子，探针只排优先级不一票否决。据此**重开**被基线假象/探针假象误杀的方向。
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3797:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_17.md:283:重判已出（reopen_under_fair_baseline-codex.md）：重开 3 方向（exp024 无姿态结构在标准 ViT-base 已有 +2.2~2.7 rank1 真信号被 SOLIDER 尺子误埋 / PARTIAL_EVIDENCE / 换衣稳定证据）；C 类真死保持（OC4超加性=数据属性、exp022贴图检测器、与CAL/CCIL/instance-wise同质）。
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3800:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_17.md:329:- C 特权信息蒸馏: 已完成,见 experiments/paper_materials/newinfo_privileged_distill-codex.md。结论是普通pose/parsing/silhouette teacher 已被 PGFL-KD、π-VL、FLAG、AOANet等占住,且 SOLIDER 已含 parsing 能力; 最值得继续探的是 3D体型+dense correspondence 残差蒸馏,其次是有视频数据时的3D skeleton/gait relation,parsing只适合作负控。
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3801:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_17.md:425:- **exp016 换衣判决（Tiny seed0 两数据集）**：LTCC 换衣 12.3/24.7、PRCC 换衣 40.1/42.4（同衣 98.2/99.5 饱和），全面大幅低于发表水位。结论：SOLIDER 人本预训练放大衣服捷径，换衣降级为分析素材（与遮挡战场形成干净对照）。协议照搬 Simple-CCReID、读取器对账 PASS、两条评测路径数字一致。
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3802:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_17.md:426:- **exp017 探针放行候选 A**：SOLIDER 特征对 CLIP 遮挡物语义零线性解码（R²=-0.01）、嵌入级超锥零假设解释力仅约 26%、残差与 AP 相关 -0.164（控 s_top1 后 -0.097 贴线）。按预注册中间地带规则的属性级判据放行。
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3803:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_17.md:442:阅读已完成：167 篇全覆盖。38 篇范围内精读 + 88 篇范围外粗读由 codex 完成（笔记 paper_notes/notes/in_*.md、out_*.md），剩 41 篇因 codex 额度耗尽（2026-06-11 13:01 恢复）由 Claude 摘要级补读（missing_41_skim_by_claude.md）。元分析和候选方向写在 **paper_notes/SYNTHESIS.md**，要点：(1) 在"单 embedding、测试无额外输入"口径下我们的 SOLIDER Swin-Small 纯基线 66.5 已处于已发表 B 类遮挡工作头部（发表水位 57.8-65.5，仅 arXiv 的 DPL-ReID 67.2 和测试期多部件距离的 AOANet 70.6 更高）；(2) 模块类增益=弱基线假象（这批论文内部基线 48-53 起步），反向验证我们 13 个判负；(3) 站得住的增益全部来自训练期新信息源（VLM 语义/外部遮挡物数据/生成数据/分布先验）；(4) 空白=遮挡结构化 VLM 语义当纯训练期监督蒸馏进非 CLIP 强人本主干、测试回纯单 embedding，没人做过。候选 A=该语义蒸馏方向（先零训练探针：冻结 SOLIDER 特征能否线性解码 CLIP 属性/遮挡物标签，解码不出的残差是否关联检索错误）；候选 B=真实遮挡物数据源+分布先验（最便宜，A 的对照轴）；候选 C=干净到遮挡的结构保持蒸馏（中风险排队）；候选 D=可靠检索稿保底投 PRCV。待办：codex 额度恢复后对候选 A 做独立新颖性红队，然后交用户挑方向。未开任何实验。

experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3958:experiments/library_167_synthesis.md:34:库里所有遮挡论文几乎全踩你死亡清单: [090/124] pose-guided+mask、[101/080/093/120] feature completion、[132/067/015/022] CLIP遮挡prompt、[009/081] part/visibility加权。**说明"backbone 上加抗遮挡模块"连 B 类都在原地踏步——但反过来: 没人质疑这些增益是不是通用正则(你的 wall-2 没人碰)=空白。**

experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:3980:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1240:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:1589:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5570:./reassess/r_2.md:1918:reassess/r_3.md:4490:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:78:"transfer_to_occluded": "Recast the occluder as a confounder and apply the same backdoor-adjustment recipe: build an \"Occluder Dictionary\" of occlusion patterns/regions stored as Gaussians with priors P(occluder), then train with P(Y|do(X))=Σ_occluder P(Y|X,occluder)·P(occluder), marginalizing over occluders so the model cannot exploit occluder-identity spurious correlations (e.g. a particular bicycle/car/pole co-occurring with certain galleries or cameras). Two concretely transferable tricks: (1) the reverse-attention masking that isolates the confounder feature from the identity feature map — directly usable to separate occluder-region features from body features without external segmentation; (2) representing each confounder as a sampled Gaussian rather than a stored feature, giving cheap synthetic occluder augmentation at the feature level. The NWGM trick keeps the marginalization a single classification, so it's nearly free at training time and zero-cost at inference.",

experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:4011:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1373:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:5307:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量,非模糊): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(LR-query vs HR-gallery, 同图K=9个lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/antialias kernel]做边缘化, Market h=12/16/20/24/32全beat普通TTA, 优势随分辨率单调递减h12 +6.5→h32 +0.5; 因子分解=**bbox检测框±1 LR-pixel的crop不确定性主导+2.84** > phase +1.76 > zoom +1.70)。**训练端已试全负**: ①consistency(拉K变体特征到均值)有害single -1.73还掉HR sanity; ②lattice-aug(训练时见lattice变体)≈普通random增广只差+0.54不lattice-specific; ③marginal-likelihood L_marg是训练有害大元凶。**铁律: 训练端做invariance/feature-collapse压判别性=死路**。目标=一个**互补的训练端创新**和test-time marginalization结合成train+test完整方法(更有把握, 6/10→7-8/10)。 ★lens=从相邻领域搬训练范式: 'LR bbox/采样格点是要边缘化的隐变量'这设定, 哪个相邻领域训练机制能映射且避开invariance-collapse? 候选评估: amortized-variational-inference(把marginalization学进网络)/detection-jitter-robust-training/test-time-training训练侧/super-resolution-as-auxiliary/deep-equilibrium/EM-style-latent。求: 最值1-2个 + 具体机制 + 廉价kill-switch + novelty(联网查) + 信心1-10 + 务实中文。死区避开通用FM-import(MLLM/DINO/SD)。
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:4012:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1403:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:4263:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5570:./reassess/r_2.md:1918:reassess/r_3.md:4490:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:78:"transfer_to_occluded": "Recast the occluder as a confounder and apply the same backdoor-adjustment recipe: build an \"Occluder Dictionary\" of occlusion patterns/regions stored as Gaussians with priors P(occluder), then train with P(Y|do(X))=Σ_occluder P(Y|X,occluder)·P(occluder), marginalizing over occluders so the model cannot exploit occluder-identity spurious correlations (e.g. a particular bicycle/car/pole co-occurring with certain galleries or cameras). Two concretely transferable tricks: (1) the reverse-attention masking that isolates the confounder feature from the identity feature map — directly usable to separate occluder-region features from body features without external segmentation; (2) representing each confounder as a sampled Gaussian rather than a stored feature, giving cheap synthetic occluder augmentation at the feature level. The NWGM trick keeps the marginalization a single classification, so it's nearly free at training time and zero-cost at inference.",

experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:4047:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1468:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_9.md:938:阅读已完成：167 篇全覆盖。38 篇范围内精读 + 88 篇范围外粗读由 codex 完成（笔记 paper_notes/notes/in_*.md、out_*.md），剩 41 篇因 codex 额度耗尽（2026-06-11 13:01 恢复）由 Claude 摘要级补读（missing_41_skim_by_claude.md）。元分析和候选方向写在 **paper_notes/SYNTHESIS.md**，要点：(1) 在"单 embedding、测试无额外输入"口径下我们的 SOLIDER Swin-Small 纯基线 66.5 已处于已发表 B 类遮挡工作头部（发表水位 57.8-65.5，仅 arXiv 的 DPL-ReID 67.2 和测试期多部件距离的 AOANet 70.6 更高）；(2) 模块类增益=弱基线假象（这批论文内部基线 48-53 起步），反向验证我们 13 个判负；(3) 站得住的增益全部来自训练期新信息源（VLM 语义/外部遮挡物数据/生成数据/分布先验）；(4) 空白=遮挡结构化 VLM 语义当纯训练期监督蒸馏进非 CLIP 强人本主干、测试回纯单 embedding，没人做过。候选 A=该语义蒸馏方向（先零训练探针：冻结 SOLIDER 特征能否线性解码 CLIP 属性/遮挡物标签，解码不出的残差是否关联检索错误）；候选 B=真实遮挡物数据源+分布先验（最便宜，A 的对照轴）；候选 C=干净到遮挡的结构保持蒸馏（中风险排队）；候选 D=可靠检索稿保底投 PRCV。待办：codex 额度恢复后对候选 A 做独立新颖性红队，然后交用户挑方向。未开任何实验。

experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:4495:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:3332:experiments/paradigm_shift/README.md:10:LM-ReID(exp359) 6.5 是最强 B 类候选，但训练端探索（守 SOLIDER/Swin 强 backbone 加小模块 + 历史模块）已 **100% 实测穷尽**。诚实结论：**不是"ReID 没训练端创新"，而是"在不换 backbone、不换量级、cheap kill-switch 的约束下，小修小补探到底了"**。真正的训练端创新是"范式级"的（换预训练/监督/数据来源）——CLIP-ReID(language)/SOLIDER(SSL pretraining)/Pose2ID(generation) 都是。用户授权松开所有约束去够这个量级。
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:4496:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:3334:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_C_free.md:14:ReID 训练端范式级创新评估(重大转向, 不要 cheap 不要判死)。背景: 守 SOLIDER/Swin 强 backbone 加小模块训练端已穷尽, 用户授权换量级可花周级时间。**算力 4 单卡 slot 无 from-scratch foundation 算力**。数据 occluded_duke/market/msmt17/occluded_reid/occluded_posetrack。**评估范式=自由(新监督信号/跨界 import/新训练目标)**。避死区: CLIP-ReID(language 占)/SMPL 几何(我项目多次证负无独特 ReID 信号)/FM-import MLLM-DINO-SD(我项目证负 判别性-互补性张力)/test-time trick。问: 2026 ReID 训练端哪个范式级方向(新监督信号如 video-temporal/attribute/synthetic-label, 或跨界 import 如 face-recognition/3D/retrieval-pretraining 训练范式, 或新训练目标)最有野心 × 4-slot 单卡周级可行 × 真 novelty × 能 actually build? 给 3 候选排序。**不判死, 选去 build + pipeline + 工作量 + 风险 + B类潜力。信心。务实中文。**
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:4500:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:3363:LM-ReID(exp359) 6.5 是最强 B 类候选，但训练端探索（守 SOLIDER/Swin 强 backbone 加小模块 + 历史模块）已 **100% 实测穷尽**。诚实结论：**不是"ReID 没训练端创新"，而是"在不换 backbone、不换量级、cheap kill-switch 的约束下，小修小补探到底了"**。真正的训练端创新是"范式级"的（换预训练/监督/数据来源）——CLIP-ReID(language)/SOLIDER(SSL pretraining)/Pose2ID(generation) 都是。用户授权松开所有约束去够这个量级。
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:4510:experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:3572:| 142-eq | PSG+GCN+SKC (Support-Supervised Keypoint Completion, eq) | 60.3% | 71.8% | 84.4% | 87.7% | vs exp030a-eq: -0.8%/-1.9% | ❌ 中性偏负。completion module 虽然活跃（gate=0.26, delta_norm=1.5），但 skc_pre≈skc_post 说明修改方向不是向 prototype 靠近。gate 无限制增长导致后期过度修改特征。feature-level completion 方向已被多轮验证为无效 |
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:4526:experiments/exp324b/_codex_review.log:14:Review two files for a person-ReID experiment exp324b: experiments/exp324b/design.md and scripts/exp324b_train_head.py (it imports helpers from scripts/exp324_dino.py — read that for context). Setup: FROZEN DINOv2-base dense tokens, pose-anchored into 5 body parts (cached), then a LIGHTWEIGHT shared Linear(768->512)+BNNeck+classifier head (~413K params, DINO never back-propped). Loss = ID CrossEntropy on BNNeck feat + batch-hard SOFT-MARGIN triplet on pre-BN global feat (global = masked-mean over visible projected parts), weight 1:1. PK sampler P=16 x K=4 = BS64. Eval = two distmats: global cosine + mutually-visible part-MaxSim (L2-normalized projected parts); mAP/R1 on ALL query and HEAVY-OCC (query pose visibility_binary.sum()<=8). Goal: lift exp324's frozen 1.86 heavy-occ mAP via training the head. Review line-by-line: bugs / runtime errors / shape-device-dtype mismatches / edge cases (zero-visible-part images, NaN); train/test asymmetry (head is supervised via GLOBAL masked-mean feature but tested via per-part normalized part-MaxSim — is this coupling sound? should there be a part-level loss?); triplet correctness (pos/neg masks, hardest mining, soft-margin); PK sampler correctness; eval correctness (same-pid-same-cam exclusion, heavy-occ mask slicing, query/gallery pose split mapping); single-variable isolation vs exp324; no LR scheduler concern. Use web search to check novelty/precedent of 'frozen foundation-model features + lightweight head + pose-part matching for occluded person ReID'. Output: Verdict (approve / needs-attention) + findings with severity (Critical/High/Medium/Low).

experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_B_pretraining.md:4725:experiments/exp324b/_codex_review.log:3276:./experiments/exp324b/_codex_review.log:14:Review two files for a person-ReID experiment exp324b: experiments/exp324b/design.md and scripts/exp324b_train_head.py (it imports helpers from scripts/exp324_dino.py — read that for context). Setup: FROZEN DINOv2-base dense tokens, pose-anchored into 5 body parts (cached), then a LIGHTWEIGHT shared Linear(768->512)+BNNeck+classifier head (~413K params, DINO never back-propped). Loss = ID CrossEntropy on BNNeck feat + batch-hard SOFT-MARGIN triplet on pre-BN global feat (global = masked-mean over visible projected parts), weight 1:1. PK sampler P=16 x K=4 = BS64. Eval = two distmats: global cosine + mutually-visible part-MaxSim (L2-normalized projected parts); mAP/R1 on ALL query and HEAVY-OCC (query pose visibility_binary.sum()<=8). Goal: lift exp324's frozen 1.86 heavy-occ mAP via training the head. Review line-by-line: bugs / runtime errors / shape-device-dtype mismatches / edge cases (zero-visible-part images, NaN); train/test asymmetry (head is supervised via GLOBAL masked-mean feature but tested via per-part normalized part-MaxSim — is this coupling sound? should there be a part-level loss?); triplet correctness (pos/neg masks, hardest mining, soft-margin); PK sampler correctness; eval correctness (same-pid-same-cam exclusion, heavy-occ mask slicing, query/gallery pose split mapping); single-variable isolation vs exp324; no LR scheduler concern. Use web search to check novelty/precedent of 'frozen foundation-model features + lightweight head + pose-part matching for occluded person ReID'. Output: Verdict (approve / needs-attention) + findings with severity (Critical/High/Medium/Low).

experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1039:experiments/decisions.md:1492:- 🔵 蓝队（方案 B）核心论点: 47 个实验中 21/21 训练端改进全部失败，贝叶斯后验 P(失败) ≈ 95.7%。CLAUDE.md 明确说"不要做 GCN 小变体"。SkeletonMAE (2023) 已在动作识别上做过 skeleton graph masked autoencoding，novelty 受限。即使涨 1%，"在 GCN 上加 MAE 辅助任务"的 story 不够支撑 B 会。应该花时间精读 2024-2025 新工作（uncertainty-aware ReID、diffusion-based augmentation 等），找到 paradigm shift 级别的创新。信心: 8/10
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1042:experiments/decisions.md:1644:**上下文**: `exp066-074` 已完成 `PAA` 系列探索，`exp075` 正在补多 seed。联网复盘了 KPR、ProFD、Pose2ID、DPEFormer、SSSC、FCFormer、TTPM 等 2024-2025 工作，并重新评估当前成果是否足以支撑 B 类会议/期刊主线。
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1055:experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lattice_result.md:69:- **OOM（run1 h=24 死）**：原版一次性 materialize 全部 2·K·Nq=60k 张 384×128 PIL（~18GB RAM）→ 31GB 机器在 h=24 被 OOM kill（无 Traceback，静默死，dmesg 无权限）。**修法**：按 query chunk（256）流式生成+提特征+释放 PIL，峰值 RSS 从 ~25GB 降到 8.5GB。streaming 版慢但内存安全，h=16 数值与 run1 一致（phase-var 0.1164 vs 0.1162）。
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1065:experiments/innovation_brainstorm.md:1092:4. **Pose2ID** (CVPR 2025): 训练无关 NFC + 身份引导行人生成
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1095:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:78:"transfer_to_occluded": "Recast the occluder as a confounder and apply the same backdoor-adjustment recipe: build an \"Occluder Dictionary\" of occlusion patterns/regions stored as Gaussians with priors P(occluder), then train with P(Y|do(X))=Σ_occluder P(Y|X,occluder)·P(occluder), marginalizing over occluders so the model cannot exploit occluder-identity spurious correlations (e.g. a particular bicycle/car/pole co-occurring with certain galleries or cameras). Two concretely transferable tricks: (1) the reverse-attention masking that isolates the confounder feature from the identity feature map — directly usable to separate occluder-region features from body features without external segmentation; (2) representing each confounder as a sampled Gaussian rather than a stored feature, giving cheap synthetic occluder augmentation at the feature level. The NWGM trick keeps the marginalization a single classification, so it's nearly free at training time and zero-cost at inference.",
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1096:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:102:"transfer_to_occluded": "Use real out-of-domain vehicle (or generic object) crops as the occluder source for copy-paste augmentation instead of synthetic gray patches or random erasing, and inject them with a controlled height-ratio so the paste lands on the lower body to mimic real vehicle-induced occlusion. This produces texture-and-color-realistic distractor occluders that better match deployment-time occlusions than random-erasing, and the epoch-wise alternation between clean and occluder-domain data acts as a regularizer pushing the model toward occlusion-invariant features — both are drop-in, annotation-free, and backbone-agnostic for any occluded ReID pipeline.",
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1097:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:118:"novel_component": "Pose-keypoint-conditioned, segmentation-mask-guided diffusion inpainting that edits only a targeted region (clothing) while freezing the rest of the body, paired with automatic quality gating (ReID-similarity + FID filters) so only geometrically/identity-faithful synthetic samples are admitted to training.",
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1098:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:119:"transfer_to_occluded": "Repurpose the mask-guided, pose-conditioned diffusion inpainting from \"swap the clothing region\" to \"fill the occluded region\": use a body-segmentation/visibility mask to mark missing or occluder-corrupted body parts, then inpaint them with OpenPose-keypoint-conditioned Stable Diffusion to synthesize plausible body content, generating occlusion-augmented training pairs (or recovered query images). Critically, transfer their two-stage quality gate — admit a recovered region only if its ReID-feature similarity to the clean identity is high and its FID is low — so hallucinated content is filtered before it pollutes training, addressing the chronic risk that completion/inpainting injects identity-inconsistent features in occluded ReID.",
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1099:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:149:"mechanism": "Occlusion is reframed as a structured, invertible distortion in feature space rather than something the backbone must learn to tolerate: clean ViT features F are corrupted into occluded features F_o by an unknown transform T, and a Latent Diffusion-guided De-Occluder (DDO) learns T^-1. DDO projects occluded ViT features (768x14x14) into a 256-channel latent, runs a conditional reverse-diffusion denoiser supervised by paired clean features (a reconstruction loss L_recon = lambda*MSE + (1-lambda)*(1-cos) added to the standard denoising loss acts like classifier guidance), and decodes a reconstructed clean embedding F_clean. F_clean and F_o are then fused via multi-head cross-attention (Q from F_clean, K/V from F_o), part-pooled with a Global-Enhanced Local Token (GELT) fusion, and trained with a modified centroid triplet loss plus per-part cross-entropy. A separate Hybrid Re-Ranking (HRR) stage exploits the closed-set assumption: it computes per-identity gallery centroids, keeps only the Top-N centroids closest to the query, and runs k-reciprocal Jaccard re-ranking restricted to that centroid-pruned candidate subset.",
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1100:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:150:"transfer_to_occluded": "This paper IS occluded ReID, so the whole pipeline is on-domain, but the single most transferable trick is treating occlusion as an explicitly invertible map T in FEATURE space and learning T^-1 with paired clean/occluded-feature supervision — instead of masking/suppressing occluded regions, you generatively reconstruct the clean identity embedding before it reaches the ReID head. Concretely transferable pieces: (1) train a feature-space de-occluder on synthetic occlusion pairs (silhouette-guided background patching + Fourier-domain adaptation to bridge synth-to-real) where the FROZEN ViT clean feature is the ground truth, so no occlusion masks are needed at test time; (2) keep both reconstructed and raw occluded features and fuse them with cross-attention (Q=clean, K/V=occluded) rather than discarding the occluded one — the reconstruction acts as a query that re-attends the raw features toward visible identity regions, which is robust when reconstruction is imperfect; (3) the reconstruction-loss-as-classifier-guidance idea turns an unconditional generative module into an identity-preserving deterministic operator, directly useful for any completion-based occluded-ReID module to avoid hallucinating wrong identities.",
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1101:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:151:"novel_component": "Formulating occlusion as a deterministic, invertible transform T in deep-feature space and learning its inverse T^-1 via a latent diffusion model supervised by paired clean ViT features — i.e. feature-space inpainting where a reconstruction loss plays the role of classifier guidance, yielding a deterministic identity-preserving de-occluder rather than a stochastic sampler, and crucially requiring no masks/pose/parsing at inference.",
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1102:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:157:"mechanism": "A ResNet-50/ViT backbone is augmented with three pose-driven modules. VARA inserts pose-keypoint-heatmap-guided soft-fusion attention into intermediate backbone layers (Conv.B2/B3) using a foreground-aware channel-attention sub-module plus a spatial cross-attention sub-module, suppressing occlusion-information diffusion before it spreads through the growing receptive field. SAM (Skeletal Area Modeling) generates soft masks for 14 predefined inter-keypoint skeletal regions via a closed-form 2D Gaussian \"radiation\" along each bone segment AB (Eqs. 3-5), whose intensity I(δ_A, δ_B) is modulated by the confidence scores δ of the two endpoint keypoints — so low-confidence (likely occluded) joints yield weak masks. SMCF then fuses these skeletal local features with backbone features via a Transformer cross-attention (skeletal features as query, backbone map as key/value), with the SAM weight map element-wise constraining the cross-attention map.",
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1106:experiments/exp197/claude_review_v2.md:109:v2 固定数量生成使得混合 batch 大小恒定为 B（与原 batch 相同），不再是 v1 的 ~B/2（期望值）。额外峰值内存 = 原 batch feature tensor 的 100%（而非 50%）。feature tensor 尺寸为 7 * B * D（~7 * 64 * 768 = 344K floats = ~1.3MB），加上 score tensor 7 * B * num_classes（~7 * 64 * 702 = 315K floats = ~1.2MB）。加上 loss_fn 内部的 dist_mat (B*B) 和中间计算，估计额外 ~50-100MB。在 3090 24GB 上安全。建议首次训练时在 monitor.md 记录 GPU 显存。
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1136:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_8.md:12135:3. 机制怎么长出来：既然 RGB 文本偏颜色，灰度图可以弱化颜色并突出体型、姿态，就自然推出 `MDG` 同时生成 RGB 和灰度伪文本；既然两种文本各有偏向，就用 `HSF` 同时约束视觉特征；`VSS` 的 ResNet+ViT 融合是补强视觉编码，和核心重定义的绑定不如 MDG/HSF 紧。

experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1157:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_19.md:612:- 第一轮三路独立 codex 审查全部不放行，但都是可修问题：新颖性 5.0/10（窄但开放，命门是门0 超加性和交互项消融）；正确性两处（衣服关系损失 detach 切断路由器、跨衣损失用了 PRCC/LTCC 不可达的异身份同衣对）；协议两处（LTCC 探针把 general 当同衣 SC、合成贴图不能与 OC4 官方数字同台）。

experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1159:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_19.md:635:- 为什么排第一：换衣是强主干仍明确失败的具体干扰（PRCC 换衣远低于同衣）；我们有独有观察（PRCC 换衣对 w 有约 7 分响应、Occ-Duke/LTCC 不响应）；已发表换衣方法都靠衣服标签/解析/CLIP/生成，"用预训练自带语义旋钮控衣服捷径、无衣服标签、测试单 embedding"是干净区分点。

experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1185:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_28.md:374:阅读已完成：167 篇全覆盖。38 篇范围内精读 + 88 篇范围外粗读由 codex 完成（笔记 paper_notes/notes/in_*.md、out_*.md），剩 41 篇因 codex 额度耗尽（2026-06-11 13:01 恢复）由 Claude 摘要级补读（missing_41_skim_by_claude.md）。元分析和候选方向写在 **paper_notes/SYNTHESIS.md**，要点：(1) 在"单 embedding、测试无额外输入"口径下我们的 SOLIDER Swin-Small 纯基线 66.5 已处于已发表 B 类遮挡工作头部（发表水位 57.8-65.5，仅 arXiv 的 DPL-ReID 67.2 和测试期多部件距离的 AOANet 70.6 更高）；(2) 模块类增益=弱基线假象（这批论文内部基线 48-53 起步），反向验证我们 13 个判负；(3) 站得住的增益全部来自训练期新信息源（VLM 语义/外部遮挡物数据/生成数据/分布先验）；(4) 空白=遮挡结构化 VLM 语义当纯训练期监督蒸馏进非 CLIP 强人本主干、测试回纯单 embedding，没人做过。候选 A=该语义蒸馏方向（先零训练探针：冻结 SOLIDER 特征能否线性解码 CLIP 属性/遮挡物标签，解码不出的残差是否关联检索错误）；候选 B=真实遮挡物数据源+分布先验（最便宜，A 的对照轴）；候选 C=干净到遮挡的结构保持蒸馏（中风险排队）；候选 D=可靠检索稿保底投 PRCV。待办：codex 额度恢复后对候选 A 做独立新颖性红队，然后交用户挑方向。未开任何实验。

experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1373:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_more_import.md:5307:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量,非模糊): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(LR-query vs HR-gallery, 同图K=9个lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/antialias kernel]做边缘化, Market h=12/16/20/24/32全beat普通TTA, 优势随分辨率单调递减h12 +6.5→h32 +0.5; 因子分解=**bbox检测框±1 LR-pixel的crop不确定性主导+2.84** > phase +1.76 > zoom +1.70)。**训练端已试全负**: ①consistency(拉K变体特征到均值)有害single -1.73还掉HR sanity; ②lattice-aug(训练时见lattice变体)≈普通random增广只差+0.54不lattice-specific; ③marginal-likelihood L_marg是训练有害大元凶。**铁律: 训练端做invariance/feature-collapse压判别性=死路**。目标=一个**互补的训练端创新**和test-time marginalization结合成train+test完整方法(更有把握, 6/10→7-8/10)。 ★lens=从相邻领域搬训练范式: 'LR bbox/采样格点是要边缘化的隐变量'这设定, 哪个相邻领域训练机制能映射且避开invariance-collapse? 候选评估: amortized-variational-inference(把marginalization学进网络)/detection-jitter-robust-training/test-time-training训练侧/super-resolution-as-auxiliary/deep-equilibrium/EM-style-latent。求: 最值1-2个 + 具体机制 + 廉价kill-switch + novelty(联网查) + 信心1-10 + 务实中文。死区避开通用FM-import(MLLM/DINO/SD)。
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1403:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:4263:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5570:./reassess/r_2.md:1918:reassess/r_3.md:4490:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:78:"transfer_to_occluded": "Recast the occluder as a confounder and apply the same backdoor-adjustment recipe: build an \"Occluder Dictionary\" of occlusion patterns/regions stored as Gaussians with priors P(occluder), then train with P(Y|do(X))=Σ_occluder P(Y|X,occluder)·P(occluder), marginalizing over occluders so the model cannot exploit occluder-identity spurious correlations (e.g. a particular bicycle/car/pole co-occurring with certain galleries or cameras). Two concretely transferable tricks: (1) the reverse-attention masking that isolates the confounder feature from the identity feature map — directly usable to separate occluder-region features from body features without external segmentation; (2) representing each confounder as a sampled Gaussian rather than a stored feature, giving cheap synthetic occluder augmentation at the feature level. The NWGM trick keeps the marginalization a single classification, so it's nearly free at training time and zero-cost at inference.",

experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1441:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:7371:- **OOM（run1 h=24 死）**：原版一次性 materialize 全部 2·K·Nq=60k 张 384×128 PIL（~18GB RAM）→ 31GB 机器在 h=24 被 OOM kill（无 Traceback，静默死，dmesg 无权限）。**修法**：按 query chunk（256）流式生成+提特征+释放 PIL，峰值 RSS 从 ~25GB 降到 8.5GB。streaming 版慢但内存安全，h=16 数值与 run1 一致（phase-var 0.1164 vs 0.1162）。
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1460:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_9.md:810:- 第一轮三路独立 codex 审查全部不放行，但都是可修问题：新颖性 5.0/10（窄但开放，命门是门0 超加性和交互项消融）；正确性两处（衣服关系损失 detach 切断路由器、跨衣损失用了 PRCC/LTCC 不可达的异身份同衣对）；协议两处（LTCC 探针把 general 当同衣 SC、合成贴图不能与 OC4 官方数字同台）。
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1461:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_9.md:824:- B 生成/合成数据: CCUP/InfinitePerson/Identity Diffuser/扩散增广,找适中成本+新颖的生成机制(换衣战场PRCC 49 vs SOTA 55-66,CCUP用百万合成预训练)。
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1462:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_9.md:833:- 为什么排第一：换衣是强主干仍明确失败的具体干扰（PRCC 换衣远低于同衣）；我们有独有观察（PRCC 换衣对 w 有约 7 分响应、Occ-Duke/LTCC 不响应）；已发表换衣方法都靠衣服标签/解析/CLIP/生成，"用预训练自带语义旋钮控衣服捷径、无衣服标签、测试单 embedding"是干净区分点。
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1463:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_9.md:848:**新方向调研进行中**：4路并行codex（思路解剖/幸存性筛选/相邻领域扫描/强论文结构逆向），写入 paper_materials/newdir_*.md。出齐后第二波（候选生成+新颖性红队），再交用户拍板。重活全交codex，Claude只做全局把控。
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1468:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_9.md:938:阅读已完成：167 篇全覆盖。38 篇范围内精读 + 88 篇范围外粗读由 codex 完成（笔记 paper_notes/notes/in_*.md、out_*.md），剩 41 篇因 codex 额度耗尽（2026-06-11 13:01 恢复）由 Claude 摘要级补读（missing_41_skim_by_claude.md）。元分析和候选方向写在 **paper_notes/SYNTHESIS.md**，要点：(1) 在"单 embedding、测试无额外输入"口径下我们的 SOLIDER Swin-Small 纯基线 66.5 已处于已发表 B 类遮挡工作头部（发表水位 57.8-65.5，仅 arXiv 的 DPL-ReID 67.2 和测试期多部件距离的 AOANet 70.6 更高）；(2) 模块类增益=弱基线假象（这批论文内部基线 48-53 起步），反向验证我们 13 个判负；(3) 站得住的增益全部来自训练期新信息源（VLM 语义/外部遮挡物数据/生成数据/分布先验）；(4) 空白=遮挡结构化 VLM 语义当纯训练期监督蒸馏进非 CLIP 强人本主干、测试回纯单 embedding，没人做过。候选 A=该语义蒸馏方向（先零训练探针：冻结 SOLIDER 特征能否线性解码 CLIP 属性/遮挡物标签，解码不出的残差是否关联检索错误）；候选 B=真实遮挡物数据源+分布先验（最便宜，A 的对照轴）；候选 C=干净到遮挡的结构保持蒸馏（中风险排队）；候选 D=可靠检索稿保底投 PRCV。待办：codex 额度恢复后对候选 A 做独立新颖性红队，然后交用户挑方向。未开任何实验。
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1474:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_9.md:6922:3. 机制怎么长出来：既然核心是可靠性，它先用多个 MLLM 生成候选描述，再用已有 TIReID 模型的图文相似度选择更可靠文本。然后只对图像聚类，把伪标签传给匹配文本，再用文本和图像类中心的相似度做 IQR 异常过滤。最后 MTJL 从类中心和实例两个层面收紧跨模态特征。
experiments/paradigm_shift/paradigm_A_generation.md:1479:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_9.md:6969:3. 机制怎么长出来：既然核心是可靠性，它先用多个 MLLM 生成候选描述，再用已有 TIReID 模型的图文相似度选择更可靠文本。然后只对图像聚类，把伪标签传给匹配文本，再用文本和图像类中心的相似度做 IQR 异常过滤。最后 MTJL 从类中心和实例两个层面收紧跨模态特征。

experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:7235:experiments/exp328_vcnorm/design.md:9:exp260b 已有 OA-SD（occluded student ↔ clean EMA teacher 双前向）+ PLBOA（下肢遮挡增广），但其蒸馏只作用在 **pooled global 特征**（cosine）。BT-PKD 进一步蒸馏 per-keypoint 特征**方向**（cosine），仍是「让被遮挡 token 的特征向 clean token 看齐」。两者都没有触碰探针指认的真正病灶：**被遮挡 per-part token 的归一化统计（一阶/二阶矩）整体漂移到一个可分离的子空间**——这是一条「有/无遮挡」的 domain 轴，叠加在身份信号上。OA-SD/BT-PKD 把个体特征拉近，但没有显式消掉这条 domain 轴；探针显示这条轴在跨域时大量残留（pre-GCN AUC 0.97），GCN 只部分修复。

experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:8020:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:3:"title": "Robust mixed-degradation person Re-identification via structural consistency distillation",
experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:8021:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:6:"transfer_to_occluded": "Treat occluded vs holistic images as the \"degraded vs clean\" domain pair and apply the Fused Gromov-Wasserstein alignment: use the Wasserstein term to pull occluded-sample features toward a training-only holistic reference branch (global centroid correction) while the Gromov-Wasserstein term enforces that the pairwise relational geometry among identities is preserved despite missing body regions. The key transferable trick is preserving intra-identity *relational structure* (GWD on pairwise distance matrices) rather than only matching absolute feature positions — occlusion warps the manifold topology of an ID, so distilling relational consistency from a holistic teacher could regularize occluded embeddings without needing aligned part correspondences. The EWC/CFR idea also transfers: when fine-tuning on occluded data, Fisher-weighted regularization against a holistic-trained checkpoint could prevent forgetting of discriminative cues that survive in visible regions.",
experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:8022:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:8:"novel_component": "Casting domain alignment as Fused Gromov-Wasserstein optimal transport that simultaneously corrects the global distribution shift (Wasserstein term) AND preserves the intra-domain pairwise relational topology of identities (Gromov-Wasserstein term) within one Sinkhorn plan — distilling *relational structure* from a clean teacher branch, not just centroid matching, with the teacher branch dropped entirely at inference."
experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:8023:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:22:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas for occluded ReID. (1) The pose loss L_p that explicitly minimizes cosine similarity between body-part features and non-human/background features — a cheap regularizer to suppress occluder/background leakage into the identity embedding, applicable to any pose- or part-based occluded model. (2) The texture-distinctiveness decoder channel aimed specifically at non-target PEDESTRIAN occlusion: when the occluder is itself a person, pose/structure cues fail (same skeleton topology), so using texture appearance distinctiveness (via pose-filtered queries cross-attending to contextual features) to push apart target vs distractor-person is a concrete mechanism for the under-addressed person-on-person occlusion case. Also transferable: replacing coarse pose-to-global mapping with a per-keypoint-to-patch confidence-gated argmax correspondence (Mahalanobis+cosine affine similarity) to localize visible regions.",
experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:8024:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:77:"mechanism": "Models clothing as a confounder C in a structural causal model X←C→Y and replaces likelihood training P(Y|X) with causal-intervention training P(Y|do(X))=Σ_c P(Y|X,c)·P(c) via backdoor adjustment, cutting the \"clothing shortcut\" backdoor path. Three modules implement it: a Confounder Dictionary storing each clothing item as a multivariate Gaussian N(μ,σ²) with prior P(c) (EMA-updated, clothing features isolated by reverse-attention masking of the identity map), an Intervention Module that samples K diverse per-clothing features, condition-injects them into the image feature and uses the NWGM trick (Eq.12) to pull the classifier out of the Σ_c sum so the whole intervention is one classification, and a Disentangle Regularization (orthogonal + KL + feature-separation losses) keeping clothing reps identity-free. Backbone-agnostic (ResNet-50 / ViT); causal/clothing streams used only in training, inference uses the identity stream alone.",
experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:8025:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:94:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly transferable ideas. (1) The OAM pairwise matching rule: derive a per-part visibility/occlusion weight (here just the spatial area of the learned region mask), then for a query-gallery pair take the MIN of the two weights per part before weighting that part's distance — so a part contributes only when it is visible in BOTH images, and the global feature is always kept at weight 1 as a fallback. This is a simple, learning-free, symmetric \"common-visible support\" rule that can wrap any part-based occluded ReID model and is directly applicable to an occluded-ReID setup that already has part/keypoint visibility scores. (2) Pose-distillation: supervise spatial part-region extractors with pose labels at TRAIN time but drop the pose model at TEST time, so pose-estimation noise on heavily-occluded test images never propagates into the features — relevant because pose error on occluded images is a known failure mode.",
experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:8026:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:101:"mechanism": "Treats large-scale vehicle images (auto-collectable via license-plate recognition, framed as \"positive-incentive noise\") as a free training resource for occluded person ReID. Two strategies: ENI alternates the training set between person-only and vehicle-only/mixed epochs every S epochs as a regularizer; INI synthesizes realistic vehicle-occluded persons by copy-pasting a randomly-sized cropped vehicle segment into the lower-body region of person images (height-ratio r controls occlusion placement). A dual-branch CNN fuses global (avg+max pool) and local (spatial-partition + max pool) features, supervised by ID cross-entropy on both branches plus triplet loss on the global feature; no parsing nets or manual masks needed.",
experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:8027:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:102:"transfer_to_occluded": "Use real out-of-domain vehicle (or generic object) crops as the occluder source for copy-paste augmentation instead of synthetic gray patches or random erasing, and inject them with a controlled height-ratio so the paste lands on the lower body to mimic real vehicle-induced occlusion. This produces texture-and-color-realistic distractor occluders that better match deployment-time occlusions than random-erasing, and the epoch-wise alternation between clean and occluder-domain data acts as a regularizer pushing the model toward occlusion-invariant features — both are drop-in, annotation-free, and backbone-agnostic for any occluded ReID pipeline.",
experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:8028:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:103:"novel_component": "Reframing an \"unwanted noise\" domain (vehicle images) as positive-incentive noise (π-noise) that, via information-theoretic argument, reduces the recognition task's conditional entropy — and operationalizing it as a cheap, annotation-free occluder source for realistic copy-paste occlusion augmentation rather than treating it as data to discard.",
experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:8029:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:110:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas (the paper IS occluded ReID, so these are native): (1) The attention-magnitude saliency for foreground/background separation — derive a per-patch foreground probability from a lightweight conv-sigmoid head trained ONLY by a foreground-background contrastive loss (no pose/parsing labels), then suppress occluder/background tokens; this is an external-prior-free occluder gate, attractive because pose estimators fail under occlusion. (2) The importance-ranked cumulative fusion (FHFM): rank patches by CLS-attention*norm and let high-confidence (likely visible) patches contribute to every fusion level while low-importance (likely occluded) patches contribute least — a soft, label-free visibility weighting that downweights corrupted regions without a hard mask. The region-restricted masked attention with learnable part tokens is also a clean parsing-free way to get part features robust to missing regions.",
experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:8030:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:133:"mechanism": "A dual-stream framework (appearance stream Ea + shape stream Es) for VI-ReID built on AGW. Body shape is parsed by a pre-trained SCHP human-parsing model; infrared shapes are unreliable because skin/background look similar in IR, so the parser misses limbs. Three components fix and exploit this: (1) Infrared Shape Restoration (ISR) — a spatial cross-attention at an intermediate backbone block where the query is built by summing the IR shape feature map and the IR appearance feature map, and key/value come from IR appearance features, so missing shape regions are searched for and restored from appearance; clean VIS shape features (no restoration) are mixed into the same loss batch to implicitly supervise the restoration. (2) Shape Feature Propagation (SFP) — a replicated 4th block of the appearance encoder (Es-tilde) is distilled from the shape stream at both instance level (L2) and prototype level (CE to class prototypes), so at inference the heavy shape stream and parser are dropped. (3) Appearance Feature Enhancement (AFE) — a cascaded two-stage cross-attention that uses shape features as query over appearance key/value to first pull out directly-shape-correlated appearance, then re-query to gather indirectly-related appearance, suppressing background/modality noise. Inference concatenates the distilled shape feature with the AFE-enhanced appearance feature.",
experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:8031:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:141:"mechanism": "Per frame, an off-the-shelf 3D human reconstruction (HMR/SMPL) produces a pedestrian mesh, which is converted to a point cloud and back-projected with image RGB; a detection-free PointPillar backbone encodes it into a pseudo-image (\"pillar-based feature\") whose dimensions are aligned with 2D ResNet image features. A Cross-Modal Fusion (CMF) module uses deformable cross-attention where pillar features are queries and 2D-to-3D mapping gives reference points, so sampling locations on the image are anchored at projected pedestrian body positions. A separate Shape-aware Spatial-Temporal Interaction (SSTI) module runs parallel spatial/temporal self-attention over SMPL shape parameters (β) to form a video-level 3D-shape descriptor; CMF fusion features (after temporal aggregation) and the SSTI shape feature are concatenated as the final representation, trained with cross-entropy + triplet.",
experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:8032:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:181:"mechanism": "For video clothes-changing ReID, instead of using sparse 3D skeletons or low-dimensional SMPL parameters for gait, the method distills dense 3D mesh-surface knowledge into the 2D image domain. It pre-trains per-vertex embeddings on the canonical SMPL mesh via a GCN, supervised so that embedding L2 distances match mesh geodesic distances and embedding angles match surface tangent angles; a lightweight U-Net extractor is then trained to assign every foreground pixel an embedding equal to its underlying 3D vertex's embedding, forming a per-frame \"structured distilled 3D gait field\" that is spatially/temporally aligned with the video. Local similarity learning plus a dual-granularity token cross-attention module (MRIE) then fuse this gait field with clothing-desensitized appearance features.",
experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:8083:experiments/exp229/claude_review.md:11:**创新性评估**: BT-PKD 不是小调参。它解决的是一个根本性问题（detach 屏障阻止 part 梯度到达 backbone），用一种新的信号类型（cosine distillation vs SupCon）来绕过 BA-PKC 的失败模式。代码修改量不大（~50行），但核心机制有创新。不属于"只改几行配置"的小调参范畴。

experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:8200:experiments/exp131/claude_review_v2.md:66:1. **Softmax 稀释**（中风险）：queue 填满后，每个 anchor 的 neg 候选从 ~48 暴增到 ~304。`_distill_subset` 中 `F.log_softmax(s_logits, dim=0)` 在全量 batch+queue 上归一化，分布更平坦，每个 pair 的 KL 信号被稀释。这可能抵消 coverage 增益。**监控指标**：观察 `csrd_qr`（queue ratio）和 CSRD loss 值变化。

experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:8220:experiments/exp131/claude_review.md:68:2. **Softmax 稀释**: `_distill_subset` 中 KL 的 softmax 在 `dim=0` 上对 batch+queue relations 一起归一化。当 queue 填满后，一个 anchor 的 neg 候选从 ~48 个暴增到 ~300 个，softmax distribution 变得更平坦，每个 pair 的信号被稀释。这可能抵消 coverage 增益。

experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:8501:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_28.md:6885:最关键的是 MIDM 单独用时会掉点或不稳，加入 adversarial decoupling loss 后提升，说明“只做掩码或 IN 不够，残差需要被正确分离”。SYSU-MM01 和 RegDB 的消融把 CDM、MIDM、对抗解耦和重组中心损失逐步加上，形成层级收益链。热力图也对准了重定义：IN 后特征激活区域有限，说明确实丢身份；负残差重组后更多激活背景，说明冗余被分出去；身份特征更多聚焦人体区域。t-SNE 从原始特征、AGW 基线、CDM 后特征到 MIDM 后特征逐步更紧、更可分，正好证明“层级净化”不是只在指标上有效。

experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:8597:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:10661:相关先例很多，但没有看到“LR-ReID 中把 sampling lattice 明确当 hidden variable 并做 lattice decision marginalization”的直接先例。CR-ReID 主流仍是 SR、resolution-invariant / adaptive representation、feature distillation 或 feature panning，如 RFD、LRAR、VPFA。set-based / multi-instance contrastive 有 SupCon、MIL-NCE、set-based ReID 等先例，所以 LSRC 的“set contrastive/logsumexp bag score”本身不新；新意只能落在 **sampling-lattice hidden variable + retrieval decision marginalization** 这个问题定义上。通用视觉里 anti-aliasing、shift/sub-pixel sensitivity 已有强先例，不能声称发现 aliasing 本身。

experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:9380:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/false_negative_audit.txt:9:| ① B 航拍不确定性包含 | Kill 基本 robust。TTA 方差确实可能不是“身份欠定度”的完美代理，但本地结果不是只靠 `σ_aerial < σ_ground`：合成退化 σ 不升反降、view-mean σ 反而更好、within-view σ 置换不掉、G→A 崩到 17.37，说明收益不是图像级物理包含，而是方差分母检索 artifact。若换成“视角语义/可见性/几何对齐”，外部已有 GSAlign / SeCap / ViSA 等 AGPReID 方向占位。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.22268?utm_source=openai)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.06965?utm_source=openai)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18192?utm_source=openai)) | 8/10 |
experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:9383:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/false_negative_audit.txt:12:| ④ OSAC 谱过坍缩 | Kill 基本 robust。训练 effective rank 反升、身份信号在 top-PC 而非谱尾、ABTT/whitening 在 k-recip 后无残余，直接打掉“seen-ID 过坍缩压掉 unseen 谱尾证据”的核心前提。理论上 NC1/类内方差可能和 global rank 不完全等价，但外部 Neural Collapse 文献并不支持“collapse 必然伤 transfer”，甚至有工作认为 NC 可泛化到新类。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2112.15121?utm_source=openai)) 机制零件还撞 VICReg / dimensional collapse / whitening 大路线。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2105.04906?utm_source=openai)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2110.09348?utm_source=openai)) | 8/10 |

experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:9490:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:4436:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:133:"mechanism": "A dual-stream framework (appearance stream Ea + shape stream Es) for VI-ReID built on AGW. Body shape is parsed by a pre-trained SCHP human-parsing model; infrared shapes are unreliable because skin/background look similar in IR, so the parser misses limbs. Three components fix and exploit this: (1) Infrared Shape Restoration (ISR) — a spatial cross-attention at an intermediate backbone block where the query is built by summing the IR shape feature map and the IR appearance feature map, and key/value come from IR appearance features, so missing shape regions are searched for and restored from appearance; clean VIS shape features (no restoration) are mixed into the same loss batch to implicitly supervise the restoration. (2) Shape Feature Propagation (SFP) — a replicated 4th block of the appearance encoder (Es-tilde) is distilled from the shape stream at both instance level (L2) and prototype level (CE to class prototypes), so at inference the heavy shape stream and parser are dropped. (3) Appearance Feature Enhancement (AFE) — a cascaded two-stage cross-attention that uses shape features as query over appearance key/value to first pull out directly-shape-correlated appearance, then re-query to gather indirectly-related appearance, suppressing background/modality noise. Inference concatenates the distilled shape feature with the AFE-enhanced appearance feature.",
experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:9537:experiments/cargo_cvpb/codex_review_raw.txt:4968:./experiments/transfer_candidates.json:133:"mechanism": "A dual-stream framework (appearance stream Ea + shape stream Es) for VI-ReID built on AGW. Body shape is parsed by a pre-trained SCHP human-parsing model; infrared shapes are unreliable because skin/background look similar in IR, so the parser misses limbs. Three components fix and exploit this: (1) Infrared Shape Restoration (ISR) — a spatial cross-attention at an intermediate backbone block where the query is built by summing the IR shape feature map and the IR appearance feature map, and key/value come from IR appearance features, so missing shape regions are searched for and restored from appearance; clean VIS shape features (no restoration) are mixed into the same loss batch to implicitly supervise the restoration. (2) Shape Feature Propagation (SFP) — a replicated 4th block of the appearance encoder (Es-tilde) is distilled from the shape stream at both instance level (L2) and prototype level (CE to class prototypes), so at inference the heavy shape stream and parser are dropped. (3) Appearance Feature Enhancement (AFE) — a cascaded two-stage cross-attention that uses shape features as query over appearance key/value to first pull out directly-shape-correlated appearance, then re-query to gather indirectly-related appearance, suppressing background/modality noise. Inference concatenates the distilled shape feature with the AFE-enhanced appearance feature.",

experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:10635:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/analyses/deep_28.txt:32:最关键的是 MIDM 单独用时会掉点或不稳，加入 adversarial decoupling loss 后提升，说明“只做掩码或 IN 不够，残差需要被正确分离”。SYSU-MM01 和 RegDB 的消融把 CDM、MIDM、对抗解耦和重组中心损失逐步加上，形成层级收益链。热力图也对准了重定义：IN 后特征激活区域有限，说明确实丢身份；负残差重组后更多激活背景，说明冗余被分出去；身份特征更多聚焦人体区域。t-SNE 从原始特征、AGW 基线、CDM 后特征到 MIDM 后特征逐步更紧、更可分，正好证明“层级净化”不是只在指标上有效。

experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:10826:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:298:4. **证据闭环**：关键消融是 Base 57.09/53.11，加 SFD 到 63.16/58.83，加 FMC 到 65.50/62.32，加 SFF 到 66.34/62.51。MD loss 的三项逐步提升，FMC 里没有 adversarial loss 时反而掉点，说明不是“随便生成特征”有效，而是要让生成 specific feature 接近真实 specific feature 且保持身份判别。特征分布图也证明 shared/specific 被分开，生成特征贴近真实特征。
experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:10834:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:820:3. 机制怎么长出来：DLF 在浅层融合低级细节和高级语义，MIA 用水平和垂直池化、分布 mask、多尺度卷积注意力提取细粒度共享信息。DSM 是主叙事，Hilbert Space Matching 用 HSIC 约束全局统计依赖，Euclidean Space Matching 用 EMA teacher classifier 和双向 KL 做互蒸馏，保局部判别和预测一致性。DSM 和“欧氏不够、希尔伯特补全局”的重定义绑定最紧。
experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:10849:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1358:最关键的是 MIDM 单独用时会掉点或不稳，加入 adversarial decoupling loss 后提升，说明“只做掩码或 IN 不够，残差需要被正确分离”。SYSU-MM01 和 RegDB 的消融把 CDM、MIDM、对抗解耦和重组中心损失逐步加上，形成层级收益链。热力图也对准了重定义：IN 后特征激活区域有限，说明确实丢身份；负残差重组后更多激活背景，说明冗余被分出去；身份特征更多聚焦人体区域。t-SNE 从原始特征、AGW 基线、CDM 后特征到 MIDM 后特征逐步更紧、更可分，正好证明“层级净化”不是只在指标上有效。

experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:11555:ReID 范式转向终局决策(调研交给你, 不判死, 帮选+审视可行性)。3 路 gap analysis 收敛: 遮挡 ReID 根问题=single-image support incomplete(项目 exp109 oracle 证 +8.5 mAP headroom)。两个最强候选二选一去 build: **#1 T-SCD(Temporal Support-Complete Distillation, 7.5/10)**: 训练用 occluded_posetrack tracklet(同 ID 多帧)构 support-complete teacher 蒸馏进单图 student, 测试单图。**#2 Intruder Identity Suppression(6.8/10)**: 遮挡重定义为另一行人身份泄漏进 target embedding, 训练合成 target+donor 显式压 donor-ID(GRL/adversarial)+clean-occluded consistency。**关键审视**: 项目 memory 记 exp109 的 +8.5 oracle headroom 是'identity-conditioned 不可实现的墙'(测试时不知 ID 没法 complete support; 三堵墙 completion/occluder-gate/95.8%可见; 当年结论'别在 ReID 内部找机制')。问: (a)T-SCD 把 identity-conditioned support 放训练端(tracklet privileged info)蒸馏进单图 student, 是真绕过 exp109 测试端墙, 还是又撞同一堵墙(privileged distillation gap/student 学不会)? 诚实判断别捧场。(b)T-SCD vs Intruder 哪个更值得 build(野心×可行×novelty×B类×绕开项目死区)? (c)选定方向的最终 pipeline + 头号风险 + 头号 kill-switch(第一周能看的)。联网查 privileged/temporal distillation to single-image occluded ReID + identity source separation ReID 的 2024-26 novelty 先例。务实中文, 信心 1-10。

experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:12302:**不推进 FGEU 作为方法稿。** 若仍想要 multi-frame ReID 的角度, 残存的 +7.57 realizable 增益只能当一个 test-time trick / set-based ReID 的小补充, 撑不起 B 类方法稿 (且 set-based ReID + UFFM/AMC 已占满该位, 见 evidence_method_design.txt 撞车核查)。
experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:12397:experiments/exp327_dinov3/claude_review.md:9:- exp326 diffusers 用法：up_blocks forward 返回单个 tensor（hook 的 `out` 是 `torch.Tensor`）；`DDIMScheduler.add_noise(original_samples, noise, timesteps)` 签名正确；UNet `get_time_embed` 接受长度 B 的 1-D int64 timestep；VAE `latent_dist.mean * scaling_factor` 确定性编码正确；空文本 embedding expand 正确；probe-then-allocate 几何逻辑可行；patch token 在缓存前 `.float()`，下游 cosine 全 fp32。
experiments/paradigm_shift/decision_tscd_vs_intruder.md:12482:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_4.md:507:**用户关键纠正（记忆 fair-baseline-not-solider）**：为什么 SOLIDER 强主干成了否决一切的理由？全 B 类语料没人用 SOLIDER/Swin 当基线，我们自定一个全场最强、没人用的基线再否决所有方案，本末倒置、自我否决。两个真错误：(1) 我把"强主干吸收 nuisance"过度泛化成对整个鲁棒性簇的判决；(2) 用便宜探针代替真训练去否决（用户反复说的"别只probe判负、要真训练"）。
